text: Deja Vu: Deja Vu (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Add a Red Seal to 1 selected card in your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Deja Vu is a Spectral that allows the player to set the seal on 1 selected card in hand to a Red Seal.

title: Deja Vu
text: Deja Vu: Usage notes: Deja Vu can overwrite an existing seal on a playing card. Jokers that retrigger cards like Hack, Mime, or Sock and Buskin will only reactivate the card 1 additional time, and they will not reactivate the Seal a second time. For example, a played Red Seal King will only activate 3 times, once for the initial trigger, once for the Red Seal, and then once more for Sock and Buskin. Red Seals work with both played scoring cards and held in hand cards.

title: Deja Vu
text: Deja Vu: Red Seals work with both played scoring cards and held in hand cards. One of the easiest and most consistent ways to reach Balatro's de facto high score, naneinf, is to make as many Red Seal Steel Kings as possible. This is because with Baron, a Red Seal on a Steel King essentially acts as 2 Steel Kings without a Red Seal. Because each time Baron triggers exponentially increases the score, the player needs to have hundreds of Baron triggers to reach naneinf. While Red Seals are not needed to achieve naneinf this way, it does make it substantially easier.

title: Deja Vu
text: Deja Vu: Face cards are the most versatile cards to have Red Seals on, even if they don't have any Enhancement or Edition. This is because they synergize with Photograph, Triboulet, Baron, Shoot the Moon, Smiley Face, Scary Face, Reserved Parking, and Business Card. Double or Nothing starts with all cards with Red Seals. Decks: Ghost Deck makes finding the Deja Vu card significantly easier. Jokers: Most Jokers benefit from Red Seals, especially those that trigger when certain cards are played. However, some Jokers benefit more from Red Seals than others, such as: Baron will give X2.25 Mult for each Red Seal King held in hand, and ~X5.06 Mult if that King is a Steel card.

title: Deja Vu
text: Deja Vu: Reserved Parking will generally give $0.25 more on average. This can change depending on retriggers and held in hand effects, see the Reserved Parking page for an explanation on the specific interactions and numbers. Bloodstone, The Idol, Ancient Joker, Photograph, and Triboulet all benefit from Red Seals as they give exponentially more Mult the more times their effects are retriggered. Hiker can also permanently add an additional +5 Chips, for a total of a permanent +10 Chips for Red Seal cards. Wee Joker can scale even faster with Red Seal 2 cards and gain +16 Chips, instead of the usual +8 Chips for each scored 2. Modifiers: Steel cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when held in hand.

title: Deja Vu
text: Deja Vu: Modifiers: Steel cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when held in hand. Gold cards with a Red Seal give $6 if held at the end of the round. With a large hand size, copy effects from Blueprint and/or Brainstorm, retrigger effects from Mime, and Red Seals, it's possible to generate thousands of dollars from this method. Glass cards with a Red Seal give X4 Mult when played, and do not increase the chance of breaking. Polychrome cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when played.

title: Deja Vu
text: Deja Vu: Polychrome cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when played. Trivia: Déjà vu is a term used to describe a feeling in which one believes they have seen or experienced something already. The card's ability to apply a Red Seal to a playing card emphasizes this term by its ability to retrigger said card a second time.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: Ectoplasm (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Add Negative to a random Joker, -1 hand size. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Ectoplasm is a Spectral card that turns a random Joker Negative at the cost of X hand size, where X = 1 + each time Ectoplasm has been used in the current run. E.g. using Ectoplasm 3 times in the same run decreases hand size by a total of 6 (1+2+3).

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: Usage notes: Ectoplasm picks the base edition Joker that receives the Negative edition randomly, similar to The Wheel of Fortune. Synergies: This card goes very well with Joker Stencil as it scales based on the number of empty Joker slots, also counting itself as an empty Joker slot. On decks with 5 Joker slots, if you had let’s say, a Showman, another Joker, and 3 Stencils, the Stencils would give a combined X27 Mult. However, even a single one of those Jokers being Negative would increase the gain to X64 Mult, or allow you to pick another Joker without harming Stencil. Blackboard benefits from the smaller hand size, as it's easier to hold onto Spades and/or Clubs only.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: Blackboard benefits from the smaller hand size, as it's easier to hold onto Spades and/or Clubs only. Raised Fist can have a better score with the smaller hand size, as it's easier to hold onto high-ranked cards. Anti-Synergies: Typecast sets Joker slots to 0 after Ante 4, at which point Ectoplasm will only reduce hand size with no upside. Five-Card Draw's small hand size makes it risky to use Ectoplasm, and it might not be too necessary due to the player having 2 extra Joker slots. Jokerless bans all methods of acquiring Jokers, which makes Ectoplasm useless.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: Jokerless bans all methods of acquiring Jokers, which makes Ectoplasm useless. Strategy: Ectoplasm grants a random Joker the Negative making it give +1 Joker slot and essentially frees up a Joker slot. This amazing effect is held back greatly by its -1 extra Hand size for each Ectoplasm used throughout the run, which can be a run killer if not used carefully, especially when considering how valuable Hand sizes are. Ectoplasm is oftentimes used to help the run for longer. By having more Joker slots, the player can potentially find new Jokers that can help the run out significantly, or duplicates of strong Jokers already owned when paired with Showman.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: Ectoplasm can only target Jokers with the Base Edition, which means it is possible to force the hand of fate and make it hit the Joker that is wanted easily. This is done by selling all Jokers with the Base edition that the player doesn't want Ectoplasm to hit, of course leaving the desired Joker as the only Joker left (besides Jokers that already have an Edition). Note that this action may kill the run if the Jokers sold are essential to the run's scoring. Note that this also means Ectoplasm can't be used if all Jokers that the player possesses already has an Edition.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: Note that this also means Ectoplasm can't be used if all Jokers that the player possesses already has an Edition. If Ectoplasm take effect upon a debuffed Joker (Perishable Joker after five rounds), the Joker slot will not increase, and selling it will result in permanent Joker slot loss, which is likely to be a bug. Due to the heavy penalty of using Ectoplasm, it is recommended the player first obtain more Hand sizes, be it granted by the Painted Deck, permanent by the Paint Brush and Palette vouchers, or replaceable by Juggler or Troubadour.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: The Hand size deduction effect of Ectoplasm can exceed the negatives, but will not end the run until the next Blind, when it sets the Hand size to 0. This can be taken advantage of by using Perkeo to make multiple copies of both Ankh and Ectoplasm and use them on one or more Eternal Jokers, with the most common one being Joker Stencil, to gain a high score for one single round.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: A major warning for using multiple Ectoplasms is that, for example, using 3 of them gives -6 Hand sizes, which on most runs means only being able to hold 4 cards or less at a time, making The Psychic a dead-end if no methods of disabling or rerolling the Boss blind is available, like Luchador, Chicot, Director's Cut or Retcon, or ways to hold more cards like Certificate or Cryptid.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: If the build requires the current Jokers that, while not too beneficial going into the late game, is needed for survival, doesn't need more Jokers to function, or suffer greatly from not having many Hand sizes, it may not be wise to use Ectoplasm, because the effect may not be beneficial to the run and the Hand size deduction effect can in turn be run-killing. Trivia: "Ectoplasm" is known as a supernatural substance that is "exteriorized" by physical mediums. In popular media, it is generally shown to be a viscous substance that is created by ghosts and spirits.

title: Ectoplasm
text: Ectoplasm: The image features candles because candles are a common set piece for summoning circles, fortune telling, Ouija reading, and other attempts to contact the paranormal. In between the candles, the image depicts a card having its spirit removed and its ectoplasm is floating and swirling around. Ectoplasm appears in the artwork for the Mega Spectral Pack. Ectoplasm is the only Spectral card compared to the others whose blue and pale baubles next to its name at the bottom of the card are smaller than usual, save for The Soul and Black Hole which do not have them at all.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Familiar (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Destroy 1 random card in your hand, add 3 random Enhanced face cards to your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Familiar is a Spectral card that destroys 1 random card in hand, then adds 3 random Enhanced face cards to hand.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Usage notes: Familiar cannot add Stone cards, similar to Incantation and Grim. Familiar cannot be used when there is only 1 card in hand, which can happen if the player's hand size is one or the player has destroyed cards until there is only 1 card left. The Fragile challenge bans Familiar. Will always create Kings, Queens, and Jacks, even with Pareidolia. Familiar, alongside other card-destroying Spectral cards Grim, Immolate, and Incantation, will not scale Glass Joker after destroying a Glass card. This is presumed to be a bug. Jokers: Hologram: Gains X0.75 Mult from the 3 added face cards.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Jokers: Hologram: Gains X0.75 Mult from the 3 added face cards. Driver's License: As added face cards are always enhanced, Familiar can prove an effective way to reach 16 Enhanced cards in the deck faster. Triboulet: 2 of the 3 possible ranks added by Familiar are affected by Triboulet, making the powerful xmult Triboulet provides more consistent to attain. This also applies to Baron, Shoot the Moon and Hit the Road, although the probabilities are rarer for these Jokers since they require a specific rank. Vampire: Can remove the innate enhancement on each face card for X0.1 Mult each.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Vampire: Can remove the innate enhancement on each face card for X0.1 Mult each. Any Joker that activates with face cards, such as Smiley Face, Reserved Parking, and Scary Face, benefits from the increased amount of face cards Familiar adds to the deck. Any retrigger joker (except Hack) can benefit from the innate enhancements on the added cards. This includes Mime for any Gold cards and Steel cards. Sock and Buskin is especially effective due to always activating on the added face cards.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Sock and Buskin is especially effective due to always activating on the added face cards. Canio benefits from adding face cards that can be destroyed, and there is a chance of a face card being destroyed when this card is used. Additionally, one of the new face cards may be a Glass card, which can break to provide more XMult. Consumables: Aura, Deja Vu, and Talisman: Can further improve the enhanced cards added by Familiar. Death: Can copy the face cards with their respective enhancements. Decks: Abandoned Deck: As Abandoned Deck starts with no face cards, it is harder to build hands with the face cards generated by Familiar.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Jokers: Erosion: Familiar adds more cards to the deck than it destroys, reducing possible mult from Erosion. Ride the Bus Disincentivizes playing face cards, which Familiar adds. Any Joker reliant on a non-Face rank has less value with more face cards added to the deck. This includes: Wee Joker 8 Ball Cloud 9 Even Steven Odd Todd Hack Fibonacci Scholar Walkie Talkie Sixth Sense Blinds: The Plant: Debuffs all face cards, weakening the cards added by Familiar and negating the enhancements. The Mark: All face cards are drawn face down, making it harder to build hands with and distinguish the cards added by Familiar.

title: Familiar
text: Familiar: Trivia: In folklore and especially witchcraft, a "familiar" is a supernatural entity believed to serve and protect witches. Familiar is part of a trio of spectral cards with very similar effects. The other cards are Grim and Incantation. These three cards share the effect of destroying one card and adding enhanced cards of specific ranks (Numbered cards for Incantation, face cards for Familiar, and Aces for Grim). The figure on the card resembles the Jack of Spades.

title: Grim
text: Grim: Grim (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Destroy 1 random card in your hand, add 2 random Enhanced Aces to your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Grim is a Spectral card that destroys one random card in hand, then adds 2 random enhanced Aces to hand.

title: Grim
text: Grim: Usage notes: Grim cannot add Stone cards, similar to Incantation and Familiar. Grim cannot be used when there is only 1 card in hand, which can happen if the player's hand size is one or the player has destroyed cards until there is only 1 card left. The Fragile challenge bans Grim. Grim, alongside other card-destroying Spectral cards Familiar, Immolate, and Incantation, will not scale Glass Joker after destroying a Glass card. This is presumed to be a bug. Decks: Abandoned Deck: As the Abandoned deck starts with fewer cards, the added Aces will be drawn more often.

title: Grim
text: Grim: Decks: Abandoned Deck: As the Abandoned deck starts with fewer cards, the added Aces will be drawn more often. Poker hands: Grim adds 2 of the same rank, which can make same-rank poker hands such as Four of a Kind easier to form. Jokers: Hologram gains X0.5 Mult from the 2 added cards. Driver's License requirement to reach 16 enhanced cards in the deck can be reached faster with the 2 added enhanced cards. Vampire can remove the innate enhancements on the Aces for X0.1 Mult each. Scholar, Fibonacci, and Odd Todd all activate on the Aces that Grim provides.

title: Grim
text: Grim: Scholar, Fibonacci, and Odd Todd all activate on the Aces that Grim provides. Hanging Chad, Seltzer, and Dusk all retrigger the innate enhancements on each Ace. This also applies to any Gold cards or Steel cards with Mime. As Grim adds 2 of a specific rank, hands consisting of multiple Aces are easier to form. This benefits jokers like Sly Joker, Zany Joker, and The Family. Consumables: Aura, Deja Vu, and Talisman: Can further improve the enhanced cards added by Grim. Death and Cryptid: Can copy the Aces with their respective enhancements. Strength: Can further increase the number of Aces in the deck. Poker hands: With more of 1 specific rank, Straights and Straight Flushes are generally harder to form.

title: Grim
text: Grim: Poker hands: With more of 1 specific rank, Straights and Straight Flushes are generally harder to form. Jokers: Erosion: As Grim adds more cards than it destroys, Erosion loses +4 Mult. Any Joker reliant on a non-Ace rank such as Hack, Baron, and Cloud 9 has less value with more Aces added to the deck. Trivia: The word "grim" in this case refers to a ghost or guardian spirit, such as a church grim.

title: Grim
text: Grim: Trivia: The word "grim" in this case refers to a ghost or guardian spirit, such as a church grim. Grim is part of a trio of spectral cards with very similar effects. The other cards are Incantation and Familiar. These three cards share the effect of destroying one card and adding enhanced cards of specific ranks (Numbered cards for Incantation, face cards for Familiar, and Aces for Grim). The sigil on the card is similar to an ace of spades, further tying into the card's effect.

title: Hex
text: Hex: Hex (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Add Polychrome to a random Joker, destroy all other Jokers. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Hex is a Spectral card that adds Polychrome to one of the currently held Jokers at random, then destroys all other held Jokers.

title: Hex
text: Hex: Usage notes: Hex cannot destroy Eternal Jokers. Hex will not apply to any Joker that already has an edition (including Negative). It also cannot be used if all Jokers already have an edition, and its Use button will be disabled. Ghost Deck starts the player with a Hex. Decks: Non-Perishable works well with Hex, as all Jokers are Eternal, allowing the player to add Polychrome to any Jokers freely without destroying other Jokers. Typecast also works with Hex, as after defeating Ante 4's boss, all Jokers will become Eternal, allowing the player to add Polychrome to any Jokers freely without destroying other Jokers.

title: Hex
text: Hex: Stakes: Playing on Black Stake and above allows Eternal Jokers to appear. Since Eternal Jokers cannot be destroyed, the player can safely use Hex to add Polychrome to any Jokers if they are Eternal. Strategy: Hex acts as a one-time use The Wheel of Fortune that always gives Polychrome, with downsides attached. Hex becomes significantly stronger From Black Stake onwards due to the presence of Eternal Jokers, which cannot be destroyed. Hex destroys Jokers, which means it is sometimes a good idea to sell all Jokers that you don't wish to be Polychrome, or that you can survive without.

title: Hex
text: Hex: If all Eternal Jokers have editions and you have a non-Eternal Joker that has no edition, then Hex is guaranteed to hit the non-Eternal Joker. Trivia: A Hex refers to the bewitching, or casting of spells or curses, on a person, creature, or object.

title: Immolate
text: Immolate: Immolate (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Destroys 5 random cards in hand, gain $20. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Immolate is a Spectral card that destroys 5 random cards in hand and gives $20.

title: Immolate
text: Immolate: Usage notes: Immolate cannot be used when there is only 1 card in hand, which can happen if the player hand size is one or has destroyed cards until there is only 1 card left. Although being a card destruction effect, Immolate destroying Glass cards will NOT scale Glass Joker by X0.75 Mult for every Glass card destroyed, wasting the Enhancement while not providing any value. This is most likely a bug. Jokers: Erosion receives +20 Mult from destroying 5 cards with Immolate (as long as the deck was not over 52 cards when using Immolate, 40 cards on Abandoned Deck, or 32 cards on Mad World).

title: Immolate
text: Immolate: Canio can receive up to X5 Mult from destroying 5 cards with Immolate and will always receive X5 Mult when using Pareidolia. Bull gains +40 Chips after using Immolate. Similarly, Bootstraps gains +8 Mult after using Immolate. Boss Blinds: Torching five cards while playing against The Serpent leaves the player with far fewer cards to play with, which will not reset to the player's normal hand size after playing a hand or performing a discard. Strategies: Immolate's effect is really powerful, as it helps get rid of unwanted cards and also provides a good cash infusion, being a great solution to economy in the early game while giving insane value for deck building in the mid-late game.

title: Immolate
text: Immolate: If the player has a smaller Hand size, any card in the given hand will more likely be hit by Immolate, reducing the randomness factor of which cards it will hit. This makes it easier to make decisions about whether using it is worth it or not. If the Jokers the player currently possesses are strong enough to win the blind no matter what hand is played, it can be a good idea to discard the cards that should be kept and use Immolate when there are no cards that the player wants to keep.

title: Immolate
text: Immolate: Do note that Immolate destroys random cards, which might drastically affect the run if it happens to land on cards the player wants to keep. However, if there are already many copies of the important card and a lot of unwanted cards are present when using Immolate, doing so may still be worth it, as destroying the junk cards will still allow the player to draw the wanted ones more consistently. Trivia: Immolate refers to a form of sacrifice of a person or object, usually by the action of burning, as shown on the card itself. In this case, the sacrifice is represented by destroying 5 cards held in hand.

title: Incantation
text: Incantation: Incantation (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Destroy 1 random card in your hand, add 4 random Enhanced numbered cards to your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Incantation is a Spectral card that allows the player to quickly add multiple enhanced Numbered cards to their hand at the cost of removing one random card from their hand first.

title: Incantation
text: Incantation: Usage notes: Incantation cannot add Stone cards, similar to Grim and Familiar. Incantation only gives cards with enhancements, not editions or seals. Incantation cannot be used when there is only 1 card in hand, which can happen if the player's hand size is one or the player has destroyed cards until there is only 1 card left. The Fragile challenge bans Incantation. However, if the player owns all Spectral cards and doesn't have Showman, Incantation can actually appear. Incantation, alongside other card-destroying Spectral cards Grim, Immolate, and Familiar, will not scale Glass Joker after destroying a Glass card. This is presumed to be a bug. Synergies: Hologram synergizes well, as using Incantation gives a free X1 Mult.

title: Incantation
text: Incantation: Synergies: Hologram synergizes well, as using Incantation gives a free X1 Mult. Vampire has a decent synergy, as it adds enhanced Numbered cards to scale up this card. Using Incantation adds enhanced cards to make progress towards Driver's License's condition of 16 enhanced cards. Jokers that care about Numbered rank synergize with Incantation if it gives their respective rank. In particular: Odd Todd gives +31 Chips for every scored 3, 5, 7, and 9. Even Steven gives +4 Mult for every scored 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Fibonacci gives +8 Mult for every scored 2, 3, 5, and 8. Hack retriggers all scored 2s, 3s, 4s, and 5s.

title: Incantation
text: Incantation: Hack retriggers all scored 2s, 3s, 4s, and 5s. Jokers: Erosion: Incantation adds more cards to the deck than it destroys, reducing possible mult from Erosion. Any Joker reliant on a non-Numbered rank such as Baron, Hit the Road, and Scholar has less value with more Numbered cards added to the deck. Trivia: An "incantation" is a magical spell or charm that is said to give special properties and mystical effects to an individual or an inanimate object.

title: Incantation
text: Incantation: Incantation is part of a trio of spectral cards with very similar effects. The other cards are Grim and Familiar. These three cards share the effect of destroying one card and adding enhanced cards of specific ranks (Numbered cards for Incantation, face cards for Familiar, and Aces for Grim). Incantation appears in the artwork for the Jumbo Spectral Pack. Incantation seems to be incorporated in the Clairvoyance Play Mat merchandise from a collaboration with Fangamer.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Medium (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Add a Purple Seal to 1 selected card in your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Medium is a Spectral card that allows the player to set the seal on 1 selected card in hand to a Purple Seal.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Usage notes: Medium can overwrite an existing seal on a playing card. Decks: Red Deck gives +1 discard, allowing the player to find and make use of Purple Seals. Jokers: Drunkard and Merry Andy provide more discards, allowing the player to find and make use of Purple Seals. The Idol, Bloodstone, Steel Joker, Wee Joker, and many other Jokers benefit from the deck fixing provided by the Tarot cards generated by Purple Seals. Egg and Gift Card both increase Joker sell value, making the Temperance cards generated from Purple Seals far more valuable. Campfire gains X0.25 Mult for every Tarot card sold. Fortune Teller gains +1 Mult for every Tarot card used.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Campfire gains X0.25 Mult for every Tarot card sold. Fortune Teller gains +1 Mult for every Tarot card used. Vampire and Driver's License can turn the enhancements from Tarot cards into permanent XMult. Enhancement Jokers (Stone Joker, Steel Joker, Glass Joker, Golden Ticket, and Lucky Cat) benefit from more Tarot cards that provide their corresponding Enhancement. Blinds: The Hook's discard effect also counts for Purple Seals. Enhancements: Gold cards can be held in hand at the end of the round for $3, and allow the player to get value out of Purple Seal cards even when out of discards.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Glass cards can be duplicated easily early game, and then played late game without worry of breaking, because the player already has so many. Consumables: Death is both created by Purple Seals, and can create more Purple Seals, exponentially increasing the player's ability to deck fix. Temperance can give at most $50, generating considerable amounts of money even without any economy Jokers if Gift Card was used. The Hermit can give at most $20, generating less but still significant amounts of money without any economy Jokers, and with less setup. Vouchers: Wasteful and Recyclomancy grant +1 discard each, making it easier to make use of Purple Seals.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Vouchers: Wasteful and Recyclomancy grant +1 discard each, making it easier to make use of Purple Seals. Crystal Ball increases Consumable slots by 1, allowing for more tarot cards to be created by Purple Seals. Grabber and Nacho Tong grant +1 hand each, allowing the player to use more throwaway hands to find Purple Seals. Decks: Nebula Deck starts with -1 consumable slot, limiting the number of Tarot cards able to be generated by Purple Seals. Blast Off starts with one fewer discard than usual. Jokers: Burglar prevents the player from discarding at all. Ramen, Green Joker, Banner and Delayed Gratification disincentivize discarding.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Jokers: Burglar prevents the player from discarding at all. Ramen, Green Joker, Banner and Delayed Gratification disincentivize discarding. Blinds: The Water starts with 0 discards which means that Purple Seals cannot be used for the round. Stakes: On Blue Stake and higher, having one less discard can make it harder to find and make use of Purple Seals. Strategies: Counterintuitively, Purple Seals should be put on high value cards. This is because although they incentivize those cards to be discarded, they also incentivize those cards to be duplicated. When many of the duplicated cards are in the deck, they provide far greater value.

title: Medium
text: Medium: Purple Seal cards should also be duplicated with Death with higher priority than other cards, even if the other cards are more powerful. This is because the new Purple Seal cards can be used to generate more Death cards, exponentially increasing the number of Purple Seals and allowing the more powerful cards to be quickly and easily duplicated later in the run. Purple Seals are most powerful to obtain early game, as obtaining one later does not allow it to be duplicated as much, and it will provide far less value. Trivia: Medium refers to an extrasensory perception a psychic can have and thus supposedly gives them the ability to mediate with spirits of different dimensions.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: Ouija (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Converts all cards in hand to a single random rank, -1 hand size. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Ouija is a Spectral card that turns all cards held in hand into a single random rank, at the cost of -1 Hand Size.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: Usage notes: Ouija cannot be used when there is only 1 card held in hand, which can happen if the player's Hand Size is 1 or they have destroyed cards until there is only 1 card left. Having a large Hand Size makes this card more useful, as more cards will be converted. Decks: Painted Deck has some of the strongest synergy with Ouija of any deck. Its +2 hand size allows it to hit two additional cards and also makes its drawback relatively negligible. This allows you to draw hands with fast planet scaling, such as Five of a Kind, frequently, mitigating the deck's downside of -1 Joker Slot.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: Ghost Deck allows the player to hold a Ouija during the round more easily, letting them unlock Five of a Kind or Flush Five earlier. Holding Ouija with The World, The Moon, The Sun, The Star, or Sigil allows the player to easily unlock Flush Five. Jokers: Jolly Joker, Zany Joker, Sly Joker, Wily Joker, The Duo, The Trio, and The Family all benefit from playing many cards of the same rank. Juggler, Troubadour, and Turtle Bean all allow more cards to be changed at a time and offset Ouija's downside. Turtle Bean's downside of limited rounds doesn't matter because Ouija is only used once.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: Turtle Bean's downside of limited rounds doesn't matter because Ouija is only used once. Jokers that rely on specific ranks like Sixth Sense, 8 Ball, Cloud 9 become more powerful if Ouija hits that rank. Ouija has anti-synergy with these Jokers if they are already held, as there is only a 1/13 chance for Ouija to hit the same rank. Poker hands: Four of a Kind, Five of a Kind, and Flush Five can be played much more consistently with the extra cards of 1 rank. Vouchers: Paint Brush and Palette allow more cards to be changed at a time and offset Ouija's downside.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: Vouchers: Paint Brush and Palette allow more cards to be changed at a time and offset Ouija's downside. Blinds: If the player holds Ouija in their consumable slots during The Serpent and only discards or plays 1 card at a time, they can change the rank of many cards at once. Decks: Five-Card Draw's reduced hand size does not allow as many cards to be changed at a time and compounds the hand size penalty. Jokers: Merry Andy and Stuntman do not allow as many cards to be changed at a time and compound the hand size penalty. Poker hands: Straight and Straight Flush become less consistent with a narrower distribution of ranks.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: Poker hands: Straight and Straight Flush become less consistent with a narrower distribution of ranks. Strategy: Ouija converts all cards held in hand into a random rank at the cost of 1 Hand size afterwards. This effect, while essentially being a huge gamble on most occasions, can be of great benefit if used properly and will help tremendously when used early enough, often giving a clear direction for deck-fixing later into the run.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: While being amazing when used early, Ouija falls off surprisingly quickly if it's found too late into the run. Most builds aim towards a few specific ranks to work, and Ouija having a (fixed) 1/13 chance for the desired rank can mess that up if not used with caution. The -1 Hand size given from using Ouija can be detrimental in a lot of cases, and as such, it is advised not to use Ouija when combined with other Hand size deduction effects such as Stuntman or Ectoplasm. Trivia: A Ouija board is a board with alphabetical letters and numbers on it and was believed to have been used to converse with spirits of those who have passed away.

title: Ouija
text: Ouija: The numbers and letters on the card's art are the ranks of playing cards: A=Aces, 2-10=Rank of 2 through 10, J=Jack, Q=Queen, K=King. Each of the cards' ranks on the Ouija board are also highlighted in a different color. Aces are colored white, numbered cards (2-10) are colored saturated gold, and face cards (King, Queen, and Jack) are dark blue. Sigil has a similar effect but affects suit instead of rank and does not have a -1 hand-size downside.

title: Sigil
text: Sigil: Sigil (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Converts all cards in hand to a single random suit. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Sigil is a Spectral card that turns all cards held in hand into a single random suit. This effect, while not incredibly impactful, can give the run some direction if used early enough.

title: Sigil
text: Sigil: Usage notes: Sigil cannot be used when there is only 1 card held in hand, which can happen if the player's Hand Size is 1 or they have destroyed cards until there is only 1 card left. Having a large Hand Size makes this card more useful, as more cards will be converted. Decks: Painted Deck has more hand size, so more cards will be changed at a time. Ghost Deck allows the player to hold a Sigil during the round more easily, letting them unlock Flush House earlier. Holding Sigil with Death or Strength, or when the deck already has more of 1 rank, can allow the player to unlock Flush Five early if the player draws well.

title: Sigil
text: Sigil: Poker hands: Flush becomes much more consistent if Sigil is used early. If used late, Sigil has anti-synergy because it can turn cards into the wrong suit for what the player is building towards. Flush House and Flush Five can be unlocked earlier and played more consistently. Jokers: Castle can be easier to use because it encourages building towards fewer suits, but it does not matter which suits those are. Droll Joker, Crafty Joker, and The Tribe all become easier to activate. Juggler, Troubadour, and Turtle Bean all allow more cards to be changed at a time. Turtle Bean's downside of limited rounds doesn't matter because Sigil is only used once.

title: Sigil
text: Sigil: Turtle Bean's downside of limited rounds doesn't matter because Sigil is only used once. Greedy Joker, Bloodstone, and other Jokers dependent on one suit become more powerful if Sigil hits the suit they affect. Sigil has anti-synergy with these Jokers if they are already held, as there is only a 1/4 chance for Sigil to hit the same suit. Vouchers: Paint Brush and Palette allow more cards to be changed at a time. Blinds: If the player holds Sigil in their consumable slots during The Serpent and only discards or plays 1 card at a time, they can change the suit of many cards at once.

title: Sigil
text: Sigil: Decks: Checkered Deck starts with only Spades and Hearts, while Sigil can still make Clubs and Diamonds, which defeats the purpose of the deck. Five-Card Draw's reduced hand size does not allow as many cards to be changed at a time. Jokers: Ancient Joker and Flower Pot can be harder to use because of the uneven distribution of suits. Merry Andy and Stuntman do not allow as many cards to be changed at a time. Trivia: The word "sigil" refers to ancient, usually primordial symbols that hold mystical powers. The symbols found on the card art are the Heart, Club, Diamond, and Spade suits (in that order).

title: Sigil
text: Sigil: The symbols found on the card art are the Heart, Club, Diamond, and Spade suits (in that order). Ouija has a similar effect, but affects rank instead of suit, and has -1 hand size penalty.

title: Talisman
text: Talisman: Talisman (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Add a Gold Seal to 1 selected card in your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Talisman is a Spectral card that allows the player to set the seal on 1 selected card in hand to a Gold Seal.

title: Talisman
text: Talisman: Usage notes: Talisman can overwrite an existing seal on a playing card. Jokers: Hanging Chad can retrigger a Gold Seal 2 additional times, providing an extra $6. Sock and Buskin gives an extra $3 per played face card with a Gold Seal. Hack is similar to Sock and Buskin, but applies to 2s, 3s, 4s, and 5s instead. Dusk gives extra money from all scored Gold Seals on the last hand of the round. Seltzer gives extra money from all scored Gold Seals for the next 10 hands. Burglar allows for more Gold Seals to be scored in a round. Economy-based scalers, such as Bull, Bootstraps, and Flash Card, appreciate the extra money brought in by Gold Seals.

title: Talisman
text: Talisman: Economy-based scalers, such as Bull, Bootstraps, and Flash Card, appreciate the extra money brought in by Gold Seals. Vouchers: Grabber and Nacho Tong provide more opportunities to score Gold Seals. Enhancements: Stone cards with a Gold Seal can be added to any less than 5 card hand to easily earn $3. Lucky cards with a Gold Seal will give $4.3 on average when played. Anti-Synergies: Vagabond is harder to use as scoring a Gold Seal can bring the player over the $4 barrier, preventing the player from getting a Tarot card on the next hand.

title: Talisman
text: Talisman: Strategies: It is recommended to put Gold Seals on cards intended to be played often, and cards that can naturally be retriggered by certain Jokers, like face cards for Sock and Buskin or 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s for Hack. It is always a good idea to play a Gold Seal card, even if it doesn't contribute much to the score, if the player has spare hands. Losing $1 for playing a hand and gaining at least $3 back is almost always a good trade-off.

title: Talisman
text: Talisman: Trivia: A "Talisman" is an ancient artifact that is said to bring magic powers, good luck, or riches to a person. This is evident in its ability to apply a Gold Seal to a card which gives $3 to the player once the card is scored.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: The Soul (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Creates a Legendary Joker, (Must have room). Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: 4 (cannot be found in shop). Sell Price: $2. The Soul is a Spectral card that creates 1 of the 5 Legendary Jokers if there is room. This is the only way to obtain Legendary Jokers.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: The Soul can only be found in Spectral Packs and Arcana Packs, where each card has a 3/1000 (0.3%) chance to be the Soul. The Soul cannot be created by Sixth Sense and Séance, nor found in the shop when using the Ghost Deck. Usage notes: Despite being able to be found in Arcana Packs, The Soul is strictly considered a Spectral card and not a Tarot card. Like normal card generation, multiple copies of The Soul cannot appear in one pack, unless with Showman. If the player is already holding all 5 legendary jokers and not holding Showman, the fall-back Joker is Joker.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: If the player is already holding all 5 legendary jokers and not holding Showman, the fall-back Joker is Joker. On gold Stake, the first Soul card used will give a legendary joker that does not yet have a Gold Sticker, to help with the Completionist++ achievement. This is done by manipulating the seed selection before starting the game, so there will be no inconsistencies if running the seed again after earning the sticker. Legendary Jokers created through Soul cannot have any functional Stickers. The only exception is during the Non-Perishable challenge, where all Jokers are Eternal. The Jokerless Challenge bans The Soul.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: The Jokerless Challenge bans The Soul. Strategy: The Soul creates a random Legendary Joker if the player has room. This is one of the rarest cards in Balatro, only having a 0.3% chance to replace a card, for every card in the pack, in Arcana Packs and Spectral Packs. It is typically very powerful, and can be the sole reason the player wins a run if used properly. One way to find The Soul is to repeatedly reset and skip for the Charm Tag, which has a small chance to contain The Soul.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: An Ethereal Tag will not work as well as the Charm Tag, since the Spectral Pack given has only 2 cards compared to Mega Arcana Pack's 5 cards, and as the chance is rolled independently for each card in the pack, it has a higher chance of giving The Soul. In addition, Charm Tags can be found on Ante 1, whereas Ethereal Tags can only be found on Ante 2+. The Soul cannot generate Eternal Jokers, which might hinder its potential with Madness, Ankh or Hex. Some Legendary jokers do not provide immediate value, which might be detrimental to the run if not considered carefully, such as Triboulet or Canio on Abandoned Deck.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: Trivia: The art style of The Soul differs from other Spectral cards, and resembles that of Tarot cards, even having a messed up number on the top. This card is also animated, with the gem beating like a heart, or perhaps something inside is trying to break out. The Tarot-like art style stems from an old demo build (around 0.8.6c), where The Soul was actually a Tarot card, as Spectral cards didn't exist yet. When The Soul turns Negative, the sprite colors of the gem are not inverted because the animated sprites are separated from the cards themselves, like legendary jokers. However, it cannot appear in a normal game as The Soul cannot be held.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: A soul tarot card is a Major Arcana card said to represent a person. Black Hole is the Planet-equivalent version of The Soul, despite both of them being Spectral cards. Both have the same 0.3% chance to replace a card, rolled independently for every card, in the packs they can appear in. The heart beat-like motion and the name of the card may be hinting at the trapped soul of a dead jester (all the Legendary Jokers being famous real or fictional jesters) begging to be released. The design of the card could also be inspired by the Cippi of Melqart.

title: The Soul
text: The Soul: The design of the card could also be inspired by the Cippi of Melqart. This and the Black Hole are the only two spectral cards to feature something on the top part of the card. The Soul features 5 rectangles, which likely indicates the 5 Legendary Jokers that can be obtained from this card.

title: Trance
text: Trance: Trance (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Add a Blue Seal to 1 selected card in your hand. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Trance is a Spectral card that allows the player to set the seal on 1 selected card in hand to a Blue Seal. This effect can serve as a very lenient mean of upgrading the player's ideal poker hand. Given how shops will not always contain the player's desired Planet card, this ensures that they can scale the ideal poker hand much more comfortably.

title: Trance
text: Trance: Usage notes: Trance can overwrite an existing Seal on a playing card. Blue Seals only generate the Planet card for the final played poker hand of round, which means it is a good idea to estimate the player's hand's strength and see if it can win the Blind, as clearing the Blind with another poker hand will not generate the player's wanted Planet card, wasting a level. Decks: Magic Deck starts with the Crystal Ball voucher, allowing for up to 3 Planet cards to be generated per round starting at Ante 1. Ghost Deck makes Trance much easier to find.

title: Trance
text: Trance: Ghost Deck makes Trance much easier to find. Jokers: Constellation is guaranteed to gain at least X0.1 Mult if you have a Blue Seal in your hand and a consumable slot available. This can go up to X0.3 Mult per round, making this an incredibly powerful combo. Satellite can be upgraded with Blue Seals if your last played Poker Hand is one that has not been leveled up yet. Mime retriggers Blue Seals, giving 2 Planet cards per seal instead of 1. Baron gives X1.5 Mult for each Blue Seal King held in hand. Reserved Parking has a 1 in 2 chance of giving $1 for each Blue Seal face card held in hand.

title: Trance
text: Trance: Reserved Parking has a 1 in 2 chance of giving $1 for each Blue Seal face card held in hand. Perkeo can duplicate the Planet card generated by the Blue Seal, providing considerable XMult when paired with Observatory. Campfire gains X0.25 Mult for every Planet card sold. Vouchers: Crystal Ball allows for up to 3 Planet cards to be made with Blue Seals. Observatory can give up to X3.375 Mult for a specific Poker Hand (not including Negative copies) and Blue Seals are the easiest way to get a specific Planet card into the consumable slots. Enhancements: Gold cards also trigger if held in hand at the end of the round, giving $3.

title: Trance
text: Trance: Enhancements: Gold cards also trigger if held in hand at the end of the round, giving $3. Steel cards also trigger when held in hand, giving X1.5 Mult. Decks: Nebula Deck removes a consumable slot, making Blue Seals less efficient. Trivia: A Trance is defined as a half-conscious mental state determined by absence of exposure to external stimuli.

title: Wraith
text: Wraith: Wraith (Spectral card). Type: Spectral. Effect: Creates a random Rare Joker, sets money to $0. Unlock Requirement: Available from start. Buy Price: $4. Sell Price: $2. Wraith is a Spectral card that spawns a Rare Joker if there is room, but also sets money to $0.

title: Wraith
text: Wraith: Usage notes: Wraith will always set money to $0 even when in the negatives, removing any debt completely. If the player is already holding all Rare Jokers and not holding Showman, the fallback Joker is Joker. Similar to other consumables that generate Jokers, such as Judgement or The Soul, the Joker created by Wraith cannot be Perishable, Eternal, or Rental. You cannot use Wraith if you have no empty Joker slots remaining (the Use button will be greyed out). The Non-Perishable challenge has Wraith create an Eternal Joker. The Jokerless challenge bans Wraith. Jokers: If the player has Credit Card and goes up to $-20 in debt, the player can gain up to $20 after using Wraith.

title: Wraith
text: Wraith: Decks: Rich get Richer is not recommended to use Wraith on, as setting money to $0 in this deck means the player can't score at all. Non-Perishable makes it very risky to use Wraith, as it spawns an Eternal Rare Joker on this deck. Jokers: It is not recommended to use Wraith if the player has Bull and/or Bootstraps, as setting money to $0 makes them lose their effect on score. Consumables: The Hermit, Temperance and Immolate get their money buffs negated after using Wraith. A strategy to avoid this (only for Temperance and Immolate) is to use Wraith, and then the other card.

title: Wraith
text: Wraith: Strategy: Wraith creates a random Rare Joker if there is room and sets money to $0. This effect can potentially be life-saving due to how strong Rare Jokers can be, but may give little benefits if the Joker it generates doesn't fit into the run. Wraith can be used to remove debt completely, which can work surprisingly well to remove the downsides of using Credit Card or The Tooth boss blind. If the build is already good enough on its own, it may not be wise to give up a Joker and use Wraith, because the Joker it generates may not be beneficial to the run and in turn can be run-killing.

title: Wraith
text: Wraith: It is a good idea to spend down before using Wraith, which will help minimize its downside and allow you to see more shop items. Being a Joker-generating card, Wraith can't generate Eternal Jokers, which might hinder its usage with Madness, Ankh, or Hex. Do note that using Wraith will not always be beneficial, and will leave a dent in the economy if there aren't backups like The Hermit or Temperance, in which case the best move is to skip it or sell it. Trivia: A wraith is defined as an apparition, or ghostly appearance of someone, usually showing up shortly before or after their death.

title: Wraith
text: Wraith: Wraith appears on a product made in partnership with Fangamer called the Clairvoyance Play Mat. The cards levitating around the apparition appear to reference the art of the Incantation spectral card.

title: Antimatter
text: Antimatter: Antimatter (Voucher). Type: Upgraded. Effect: +1 Joker Slot. Unlock Requirement: Redeem Blank 10 total times. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades from: Blank. Antimatter is a voucher that adds one additional Joker slot, making it arguably the best Voucher in the game.

title: Antimatter
text: Antimatter: Usage notes: The player must redeem Blank 10 times in total during unseeded, non-challenge runs to unlock Antimatter. Like other upgraded vouchers, the base voucher (Blank) must be purchased in the same run for Antimatter to appear. The Jokerless challenge bans Antimatter. Decks: Painted Deck and Blast Off: Antimatter can make up for losing the Joker slot. Cruelty: Antimatter can partially offset -2 Joker slots penalty. Poker hands: Antimatter doesn't synergize with any specific poker hands. Jokers: Generally, Jokers triggered on other Jokers or Joker slots will have synergies with Antimatter, including: Abstract Joker: An additional +3 Mult if all slots are filled. Swashbuckler: Allows for more sell value to be converted into Mult.

title: Antimatter
text: Antimatter: Swashbuckler: Allows for more sell value to be converted into Mult. Gift Card: Total sell value will accumulate more quickly. Baseball Card: Holding an extra Uncommon Joker will grant an additional X1.5 Mult. Joker Stencil: An extra Joker slot allows this Joker to gain an additional X1 Mult, whilst holding other Jokers will be less consequential to its scoring power. In addition to the above, the extra Joker slot makes it less punishing to have passive effect Jokers that provide no direct scoring, such as Splash, Shortcut, or Luchador. Consumables: Temperance will earn the player more money if all Joker slots are filled.

title: Antimatter
text: Antimatter: Consumables: Temperance will earn the player more money if all Joker slots are filled. Trivia: The Antimatter Voucher is always displayed in game as if it was a negative edition, and has a similar effect to having a Negative Joker. The only exception to this is when the player purchases Blank for the 10th time. The Voucher Unlocked message will display the Voucher without the Negative effect applied. During the Balatro release date trailer, Antimatter appears different, sporting pink and blue as opposed to the modern day teal and purple.

title: Blank
text: Blank: Blank (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: Does nothing?. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Antimatter. Blank is a voucher that has no effect. However, it is capable of unlocking the next voucher, Antimatter, after it has been purchased at least 10 times in unseeded, non-Challenge runs. Antimatter will not appear before Blank has been purchased during the current run.

title: Blank
text: Blank: Usage notes: If the player manages to purchase all unlocked vouchers in a single run, the only voucher that will appear in The Shop is the Blank Voucher. Blank is still available on Jokerless, but purchasing it does nothing as Antimatter is banned. Decks: Yellow Deck: The extra cash makes it less of an investment to buy the blank voucher before Antimatter. Green Deck: The lack of interest means it's less costly on cash outs to buy Blank. Poker hands: Blank doesn't synergize with any specific poker hands. Jokers: Blank is usually a good choice to take if you're able to afford it, since getting an extra Joker slot from Antimatter is almost always beneficial.

title: Blank
text: Blank: Other quick sources of money such as The Hermit, Temperance, Immolate, or various tags, for the same reasons as Yellow Deck and money-making Jokers. Anti-Synergies: Jokerless bans Antimatter, which means that Blank will do absolutely nothing.

title: Clearance Sale
text: Clearance Sale: Clearance Sale (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: All cards and packs in shop are 25% off. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Liquidation. Clearance Sale is a Voucher that reduces the price of cards, packs, and vouchers in the shop by 25%.

title: Clearance Sale
text: Clearance Sale: Usage Notes: Clearance Sale will reduce the sell value of all Jokers and Consumables, including those held before purchasing Clearance Sale. Prices affected by Clearance Sale are always rounded half down. Clearance Sale does affect the cost of Vouchers, despite not being mentioned explicitly in the in-game text. Only reroll costs are not affected by it. The Inflation challenge bans Clearance Sale. Synergies: As Clearance Sale's effect is percentage-based, anything purchased that costs $8 or more will have a larger absolute cost reduction of at least $2. This includes: All Vouchers. The high-cost Uncommon Jokers Joker Stencil, Fibonacci, and Astronomer. Most Rare Jokers, with the exceptions of Stuntman and Driver's License. Most Jokers with editions.

title: Clearance Sale
text: Clearance Sale: Most Rare Jokers, with the exceptions of Stuntman and Driver's License. Most Jokers with editions. Jokers: Campfire: Cards are cheaper to buy, making Campfire cheaper to scale. Constellation and Fortune Teller: Planet and Tarot cards become cheaper, making scaling these Jokers easier. Red Card and Hallucination: Since Booster Packs are cheaper, Red Card is cheaper to scale and Hallucination is cheaper to activate. Bull and Bootstraps: More purchases can be made while still preserving enough money to score high. Chaos the Clown: Allows more reduced cost cards to be seen at no cost. Clearance Sale effectively makes every Economy Joker more powerful, as it allows more items to be bought with the same amount of money.

title: Clearance Sale
text: Clearance Sale: Vouchers: Hone and Glow Up: Editioned Jokers cost more, so having Clearance Sale can help with the price increase. Reroll Surplus and Reroll Glut: Allows you to see more reduced cost cards for cheaper. Overstock and Overstock Plus: Allows you to see more reduced cost cards per reroll. Anti-Synergies: Any Shop items that already cost the minimum of $1 (or are free) will gain no benefit from Clearance Sale. This includes: Base and Enhanced playing cards purchasable with Magic Trick/ Illusion. Rental Jokers. Credit Card, which always costs $1. Planet cards made free with Astronomer. Coupon Tag, which makes initial Jokers, Consumables, and Booster Packs free.

title: Clearance Sale
text: Clearance Sale: Planet cards made free with Astronomer. Coupon Tag, which makes initial Jokers, Consumables, and Booster Packs free. Decks: The Anaglyph Deck, which encourages skipping, makes Clearance Sale less valuable due to its effect only working in the Shop. Jokers: Since the sell value of your Jokers and Consumables decreases, any Joker or Consumable that gives a benefit from sell value has a reduced effect: Swashbuckler will have less mult. Ceremonial Dagger will gain less mult per joker destroyed. Temperance will give less money. Strategies: As Clearance Sale's effect only applies in The Shop, skipping becomes less valuable and therefore less recommended.

title: Clearance Sale
text: Clearance Sale: Strategies: As Clearance Sale's effect only applies in The Shop, skipping becomes less valuable and therefore less recommended. Trivia: A clearance sale is a special type of sale given out by retailers where items are sold at a heavily discounted price, encouraging people to buy them. These sales usually occur when a store needs to make room for new inventory or if the store is going out of business. The voucher reflects this, as now all items sold in the Shop will have their price reduced by 25%.

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: Crystal Ball (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: +1 consumable slot. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Omen Globe. Crystal Ball is a voucher that increases Consumable slots by 1.

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: Usage notes: The Magic Deck starts with one copy of Crystal Ball. Crystal Ball will increase Consumables slots from 2 to 3 on most decks, and from 1 to 2 on Nebula Deck. Decks: Nebula Deck: Mitigates the downside of -1 Consumable Slot. Zodiac Deck: Allows you to hold the more abundant Tarot cards that appear in each shop for use in-ante. Jokers: Showman: Allows you to easily find and hold up to 3 copies of the same Consumable. This can be especially useful with multiple copies of The Fool or with an abundance of money for rerolls to maximise available deck fixing per shop. Any Joker that creates consumables benefits from the extra space. This includes:

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: Any Joker that creates consumables benefits from the extra space. This includes: Cartomancer: Creates a Tarot card when entering a blind. Vagabond: Creates a Tarot card after each hand played when at $4 or less. Superposition: Creates a Tarot card after playing a Straight containing an Ace. Séance: Creates a Spectral card after playing a Straight Flush. Sixth Sense: If first hand of round is a single six, it is destroyed and a Spectral card is created. Hallucination: Creates a Tarot card 50% of the time after opening a Booster Pack.

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: Hallucination: Creates a Tarot card 50% of the time after opening a Booster Pack. The additional consumable slot is especially effective with 8 Ball, due to it generating consumables through many repetitions of low odds. Crystal Ball raises the ceiling of possible consumable payouts due to 8 Ball's Tarot generation being reliant on retriggers, which may be large enough to consistently generate more than 2 cards. This applies even moreso with Oops! All 6s increasing the odds of 8 Ball. Consumables: The High Priestess and The Emperor: Having more consumable slots available allows you to hold onto an additional card (such as The Fool) while using and still gaining the full effect of these cards.

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: With Nebula Deck Crystal Ball allows these cards to work at full effect at all, due to the reduced starting consumable slots. Vouchers: Observatory: Crystal Ball allows you to gain an additional X1.5 Mult from Observatory by holding an additional Planet card. Showman: Makes it easier to find copies of the same Planet cards to be held for Observatory. Tarot Merchant and Tarot Tycoon: Makes it easier to fill up all slots with tarot cards to be held for use in-ante. Modifiers: Blue Seal: Allows for up to 3 Planet cards to be made with blue seals per blind. Mime can easily fill up these slots by giving 2 Planet cards per blue seal held in hand.

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: Mime can easily fill up these slots by giving 2 Planet cards per blue seal held in hand. Trivia: A crystal ball is an object commonly associated with witchcraft and fortune-telling for its purported use in telling someone's future. This appears to be the influence behind its relation with other magic and esotericism themed mechanics, namely tarot cards. In the demo version of Balatro, Crystal Ball had a completely different effect, where it unlocked a feature called "Tarot Reading," allowing you to choose 1 of up to 2 random tarot cards before the start of each round.

title: Crystal Ball
text: Crystal Ball: In reality, tarot readings follow a similar principle, to which a person chooses either 3 cards for more simple readings or 5 cards for more complex readings to give more insight into their present and potential future events. Also in the demo, the Telescope voucher unlocked "Planetarium," which had the same effect except for planet cards.

title: Director's Cut
text: Director's Cut: Director's Cut (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: Reroll Boss Blind 1 time per Ante, $10 per roll. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Retcon. Director's Cut is a voucher that allows the player to reroll the boss blind once each Ante for $10.

title: Director's Cut
text: Director's Cut: Usage notes: Rerolling on Ante 8 (or a multiple of 8) will always roll a Showdown Blind, and other antes will always roll a normal Boss Blind. Decks: Green Deck can allow you to gain more money in order to purchase then use this voucher. Yellow Deck may help you with the cost of this as well. Poker hands: Any poker hands you have that are countered by the current boss blind can be avoided, by using this voucher. For example, The Plant can be changed into a boss that does not debuff a deck reliant on face cards. Jokers: Matador can benefit depending on what the rerolled boss blind becomes, and your own deck.

title: Director's Cut
text: Director's Cut: Jokers: Matador can benefit depending on what the rerolled boss blind becomes, and your own deck. Having a strong economy with Jokers like To the Moon, Satellite, Mail-In Rebate, etc. may be necessary to keep rerolling the Blinds since it's expensive. Jokers: Chicot and Luchador can disable the current boss effect, making this voucher less useful. However, since Chicot’s ability to disable boss blinds allows you to gain Hand size if you have multiple of that card when facing The Manacle, it can be worth it to reroll for the Manacle. Unfortunately, due to this requiring you to have multiple Chicots, it is unlikely that this strategy can be viable.

title: Director's Cut
text: Director's Cut: Tags: When using the Boss Tag, the game will also consider the reroll from the voucher to be used. This means that the player will not be able to reroll the current ante's boss blind again using Director's Cut after taking this tag. Trivia: Director's Cuts are the version of the film the director personally envisioned. This voucher is similarly, changing the original version of the run, into something the player would prefer.

title: Glow Up
text: Glow Up: Glow Up (Voucher). Type: Upgraded. Effect: Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome cards appear 4X more often. Unlock Requirement: Have at least 5 Joker cards with Foil, Holographic, or Polychrome (or Negative) effect. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades from: Hone. Glow Up is a Voucher that causes Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome cards of all types to appear even more often. Polychrome actually appears 7x more often with Glow Up purchased.

title: Glow Up
text: Glow Up: Usage notes: Glow Up does not increase the probability of Negative Jokers. Therefore, due to the edition generation mechanism in game, Polychrome Jokers actually appear 7x more often with Glow Up. More information can be found on appearance rates. Hone must be purchased in the same run for Glow Up to appear. Only playing cards in Standard Packs will be affected by Glow Up. Those that appear in shop by Illusion will not. The player must have at least 5 Jokers with Foil, Holographic, Polychrome, or Negative at the same time in a run to unlock Glow Up. Note that the unlock isn't given immediately upon acquiring the 5th Joker, at least one further action is needed.

title: Glow Up
text: Glow Up: Synergies: Having a strong economy with Jokers like Mail-In Rebate, Golden Joker, Business Card, etc. may be necessary to purchase the enhanced Jokers since their price will be increased. Invisible Joker and Ankh can copy the edition of the Jokers (except Negative) making it even more valuable. Swashbuckler gains more Mult from the enhanced Jokers since they're worth more. This also applies to Temperance, so you can get more money from it. Ceremonial Dagger can also potentially scale faster with the higher value Jokers. Clearance Sale and Liquidation can help with the increased cost of the enhanced Jokers. The Coupon Tag can also mitigate this. Note that these vouchers diminish Swashbuckler's Mult and Temperance's Money.

title: Glow Up
text: Glow Up: The Coupon Tag can also mitigate this. Note that these vouchers diminish Swashbuckler's Mult and Temperance's Money. Trivia: "Glow up" is an informal term used to describe a thing a person which has become a more attractive and accomplished version of themselves, which refers to editions being the best versions of joker cards. The Glow Up voucher is the only voucher in the game to have an outline behind its name that has multiple colors instead of a single color.

title: Grabber
text: Grabber: Grabber (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: Permanently gain +1 hand per round. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Nacho Tong. Grabber is a voucher that increases the number of hands per round by 1.

title: Grabber
text: Grabber: Usage Notes: The Blast Off and Golden Needle challenges ban Grabber. Decks: Blue Deck: Since it has +1 hand by default, Grabber gives Blue Deck the most amount of hands out of any deck. Green Deck: Gives $2 at end of round if hand goes unused. Black Deck: Helps make up for Black Deck's lack of Hands. Jokers: All Jokers that scale upon hand played, such as Green Joker, Square Joker, and Ride the Bus have more opportunities to scale. Troubadour's -1 Hand has less of an effect. Card Sharp: The extra hand allows more possible hands to be played with the X3 Mult active. Loyalty Card becomes easier to activate.

title: Grabber
text: Grabber: Loyalty Card becomes easier to activate. Space Joker: The extra hand gives more opportunities for Space Joker to activate. Hiker: Grabber allows more cards to be played and upgraded. Vagabond: Allows for the generation of 1 more Tarot card per Blind. Reserved Parking and Matador: Grabber allows for the generation of more money. Tags: Handy Tag will give more money. Vouchers: Hieroglyph: Helps make up for Hieroglyph's -1 Hand downside. Trivia: Grabber's art is based on the hand of LocalThunk himself.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Hieroglyph (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: -1 Ante,, -1 hand each round. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Petroglyph. Hieroglyph is a voucher that decreases the ante by 1, at the cost of losing 1 hand each round.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Usage Notes: Hieroglyph cannot reduce hands per round below 1 when it's equipped against Golden Needle (Challenge) or The Needle blind, as players always start with 1 hand per round. Hieroglyph can cause certain Boss Blinds or Showdown Blinds to appear on antes they wouldn't normally be able to appear on, since the Boss Blind doesn't change after Hieroglyph is purchased. Rerolling the Blind after purchasing Hieroglyph will change it back into an expected Boss Blind. Ante 0 can be reached by purchasing a Hieroglyph on Ante 1. Ante -1 can be reached via incredibly rare circumstances, involving a voucher tag, very fast reflexes, and the seed to roll both Hieroglyph and Petroglyph. A basic demonstration can be found here.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Hieroglyph actually just reduces the Ante value by 1, without ending or starting Antes, so Ante-related effects (such as The Pillar) will still work as usual. If the player obtains Hieroglyph in Ante 9, returns to Ante 8 and fails, non-Endless mode game over scenes will be used (i.e., the background turns red and Jimbo appears). This may be a bug. Decks: Blue Deck gives +1 hand, which can mitigate the -1 hand penalty of Hieroglyph. Golden Needle starts with 1 hand, and Hieroglyph cannot reduce hands below one, making this Voucher free to take.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Golden Needle starts with 1 hand, and Hieroglyph cannot reduce hands below one, making this Voucher free to take. Jokers: Jokers that rely on scaling can benefit from Hieroglyph with the extra Ante. By playing more rounds, you give your Jokers more chances to get stronger. For example: Square Joker, Lucky Cat, Castle, etc. Alternatively, Throwback can gain more XMult by skipping more Blinds. Jokers that can potentially reward you for playing more Blinds. You can get more value from these Jokers this way. Economy Jokers such as Satellite, Golden Joker, Mail-In Rebate, etc. Tarot and Spectral card Jokers such as Vagabond, Superposition, Séance, etc.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Tarot and Spectral card Jokers such as Vagabond, Superposition, Séance, etc. With up to three more Blinds with the additional Ante, Burnt Joker will get more chances to activate. This also includes Jokers like Trading Card, Marble Joker, Space Joker, etc. Cards with Seals can be activated more with the extra Blind. Burglar can mitigate the -1 hand penalty of Hieroglyph. Vouchers: Grabber and Nacho Tong both give +1 hand, which can mitigate the -1 hand penalty of Hieroglyph. Decks: Green Deck will give the player $2 less at the end of each blind. Black Deck makes it difficult to use Hieroglyph, as its -1 hand per round penalty means players will only have 2 hands to beat each blind.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Similarly, Blast Off makes it even more difficult to use Hieroglyph, as its -1 hand per round penalty means players will only have 1 hand to beat each blind. Jokers: Troubadour is not recommended, as its -1 hand penalty means the player will only have 2 hands to beat each blind. Card Sharp can activate one less time. Loyalty Card becomes harder to activate. Tags: Handy Tag will give less money. Stakes: On Blue Stake or higher, Hieroglyph becomes more difficult to use with the -1 discard restriction from the start of the run. This means it may be more difficult to get the poker hand you need before the end of the round.

title: Hieroglyph
text: Hieroglyph: Trivia: "Hieroglyphs" generally refer to Egyptian hieroglyphs, a writing system that used symbols or pictures to stand for sounds and words. Due to hieroglyphs being an ancient writing system from centuries ago, the effect of the voucher sending the player back an ante can be interpreted as them being sent backwards in time. The symbol found on the card art seems to be the Eye of Horus, an ancient Egyptian symbol.

title: Hone
text: Hone: Hone (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome cards appear 2X more often. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Glow Up. Hone is a Voucher that causes Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome cards of all types to appear more often. Polychrome actually appears 3x more often with Hone purchased.

title: Hone
text: Hone: Usage notes: Hone does not increase the probability of Negative Jokers. Therefore, due to the edition generation mechanism in game, Polychrome Jokers actually appear 3x more often with Hone. More information can be found on appearance rates. Only playing cards in Standard Packs will be affected by Hone. Those that appear in shop by Illusion will not. Hone can be useful for helping unlock Glow Up, since having 5 editioned Jokers is required to unlock it. Synergies: Having a strong economy with Jokers like Mail-In Rebate, Golden Joker, Business Card, etc. may be necessary to purchase the enhanced Jokers since their price will be increased.

title: Hone
text: Hone: Invisible Joker and Ankh can copy the edition of the Jokers (except Negative) making it even more valuable. Swashbuckler gains more Mult from the enhanced Jokers since they're worth more. This also applies to Temperance, so you can get more money from it. Ceremonial Dagger can also potentially scale faster with the higher value Jokers. Clearance Sale and Liquidation can help with the increased cost of the enhanced Jokers. The Coupon Tag can also mitigate this. Note that these vouchers diminish Swashbuckler's Mult and Temperance's Money.

title: Illusion
text: Illusion: Illusion (Voucher). Type: Upgraded. Effect: Playing cards in shop may have an Enhancement, Edition, and/or a Seal. Unlock Requirement: Buy a total of 20 Playing cards from the shop. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades from: Magic Trick. Illusion is a voucher that allows playing cards in the shop to have enhancements or editions. Playing cards in the shop will be enhanced 40% of the time, and editioned 20% of the time.

title: Illusion
text: Illusion: Illusion is currently (v1.0.1o-FULL) bugged, and cards in the shop cannot have seals like the effect states, only enhancements and/or editions. The chance for playing cards to have an edition are unaffected by Hone and Glow Up. Usage notes: The player must buy a total of 20 Playing cards from the shop across runs to unlock Illusion. This is only possible with Magic Trick. Since buying unhelpful cards will worsen the player's deck, the player may wish buy the required cards after winning a run as the deck doesn't matter anymore. Magic Trick must be purchased in the same run for Illusion to appear. The Fragile challenge bans Illusion.

title: Illusion
text: Illusion: Magic Trick must be purchased in the same run for Illusion to appear. The Fragile challenge bans Illusion. The Bram Poker challenge starts with a copy of Illusion and Magic Trick. Synergies: Hologram and Blue Joker: Similar to Magic Trick, Illusion provides an easy way to purchase Playing cards from the shop, with the added benefit that the cards are more useful. Although, it could also be seen as a downgrade as the Playing cards with enhancements and editions are more expensive. Jokers that require specific enhancements, such as Stone Joker, Steel Joker, and Glass Joker can have their respective cards chosen selectively.

title: Illusion
text: Illusion: Since Illusion allows the player to buy enhancement cards in the Shop, Vampire can scale faster or Driver's License can get online faster.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: Liquidation (Voucher). Type: Upgraded. Effect: All cards and packs in shop are 50% off. Unlock Requirement: Redeem at least 10 Voucher cards in one run. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades from: Clearance Sale. Liquidation is a Voucher that reduces the price of cards, packs, and vouchers in the shop by 50%. This also reduces the sell value of all jokers, including your present ones. Prices are rounded half down.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: Usage Notes: Liquidation will reduce the sell value of all Jokers and Consumables, including those held before purchasing Liquidation. Prices affected by Liquidation are always rounded half down. Liquidation does affect the cost of Vouchers, despite not being mentioned explicitly in the in-game text. Only reroll costs are not affected by it. The Inflation challenge bans Liquidation. The player must redeem at least 10 Vouchers in a single run to unlock Liquidation. This can be done with the Hieroglyph and Petroglyph Vouchers by giving you 1 extra Ante each. Voucher Tag can provide an extra Voucher in the Shop. You can also go to Ante 10 or higher, and purchase the Vouchers then.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: You can also go to Ante 10 or higher, and purchase the Vouchers then. Clearance Sale must be purchased in the same run for Liquidation to appear. This effectively makes Liquidation always cost $7, despite having a base cost of $10. Synergies: As Liquidation's effect is percentage based, items with higher prices will have more discounts, for example, these items costs $8 or more, and will have a cost reduction of at least $4: All Vouchers. The high-cost Uncommon Jokers Joker Stencil, Fibonacci, and Astronomer. Most Rare Jokers, with the exceptions of Stuntman and Driver's License. Most Jokers with editions. Jokers: Campfire: Cards are cheaper to buy, making Campfire cheaper to scale.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: Most Jokers with editions. Jokers: Campfire: Cards are cheaper to buy, making Campfire cheaper to scale. Constellation and Fortune Teller: Planet and Tarot cards become cheaper, making scaling these Jokers easier. Red Card and Hallucination: Since Booster Packs are cheaper, Red Card is cheaper to scale and Hallucination is cheaper to activate. Bull and Bootstraps: More purchases can be made while still preserving enough money to score high. Chaos the Clown: Allows more reduced cost cards to be seen at no cost. Liquidation effectively makes every Economy Joker more powerful, as it allows more items to be bought with the same amount of money.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: Vouchers: Hone and Glow Up: Editioned Jokers cost more, so having Liquidation can help with the price increase. Reroll Surplus and Reroll Glut: Allows you to see more reduced cost cards for cheaper. Overstock and Overstock Plus: Allows you to see more reduced cost cards per reroll. Anti-Synergies: Any Shop items that already cost the minimum of $1 (or are free) will gain no benefit from Liquidation. This includes: Base and Enhanced playing cards purchasable with Magic Trick/ Illusion. Rental Jokers. Credit Card, which always costs $1. Planet cards made free with Astronomer. Coupon Tag, which makes initial Jokers, Consumables, and Booster Packs free.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: Planet cards made free with Astronomer. Coupon Tag, which makes initial Jokers, Consumables, and Booster Packs free. Decks: The Anaglyph Deck, which encourages skipping, makes Liquidation less valuable due to its effect only working in the Shop. Jokers: Since the sell value of your Jokers and Consumables decreases, any Joker or Consumable that gives a benefit from sell value has a reduced effect: Swashbuckler will have less mult. Ceremonial Dagger will gain less mult per joker destroyed. Temperance will give less money. Strategies: As Liquidation's effect only applies in The Shop, skipping becomes less valuable and therefore less recommended.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation: Strategies: As Liquidation's effect only applies in The Shop, skipping becomes less valuable and therefore less recommended. Trivia: Liquidation is the accounting process by which a company is brought to an end, where it will sometimes sell off all of its wares at greatly reduced prices.

title: Magic Trick
text: Magic Trick: Magic Trick (Voucher). Type: Base. Effect: Playing cards can be purchased from the shop. Unlock Requirement: Unlocked from the start. Buy Price: $10. Upgrades to: Illusion. Magic Trick is a voucher that allows the player to purchase Playing cards directly from the shop for $1 each. Without Illusion, these Playing cards cannot have enhancements or editions.

title: Magic Trick
text: Magic Trick: After purchasing this Voucher, and with no other Vouchers that increase the appearance rates of Consumables in the Shop (Planet Merchant, Planet Tycoon, Tarot Merchant, or Tarot Tycoon), Playing cards will appear in the Shop as often as Planet cards or Tarot cards. Usage notes: The Fragile challenge bans Magic Trick. The Bram Poker challenge starts with a copy of Magic Trick and Illusion. Hone and Glow Up do not affect the playing cards in the shop from Magic Trick. Decks: Abandoned Deck and Mad World: Fewer starting cards allows those added with Magic Trick to appear more frequently. Jokers: Hologram: Each purchased playing card gives X0.25 Mult.

title: Magic Trick
text: Magic Trick: Jokers: Hologram: Each purchased playing card gives X0.25 Mult. Trading Card: Allows you to trim your deck, and avoid bloating it after buying the extra Playing cards from the shop. Blue Joker: Gains more chips for each remaining card in the deck, which Magic Trick can quickly increase. Chaos the Clown: Gives 1 free reroll per shop to find more playing cards. Jokers that require specific ranks, such as Cloud 9, Wee Joker, and Shoot the Moon can have their respective cards chosen selectively. Sixth Sense is particularly effective due to destroying any gained sixes which avoids bloating the deck.
