Four Fingers allows a Stone card to be scored when playing a Straight, Flush, or Straight Flush. However, leveling up these hands gives a solid amount of chips, so Stone cards are usually not necessary.

title: Stone cards
text: Stone cards: Hanging Chad can retrigger a Stone card 2 additional times, giving 150 Chips. This can be a massive boost in score, especially if your played poker hand is at a low level. Pareidolia also makes Stone cards treated as face cards, thus able to work with effects triggered from face cards. Note when combined with Pareidolia, Midas Mask will also change stone cards to Gold cards, which may ruin a run based on Stone cards. Seltzer and Dusk can double the Chips given from each Stone card. (Sock and Buskin can do the same if Pareidolia is owned.)

title: Stone cards
text: Stone cards: The Idol cannot choose a Stone card when selecting a random card from your deck. Stone cards can be used in a similar way to other means of deck fixing to make The Idol more likely to land on your desired card. Hiker can be used to continue to increase the value of each Stone card. Poker hands: The following hands must be made from five cards, so the player cannot play Stone cards alongside them: Straight* Flush* Full House Straight Flush (and Royal Flush)* Five of a Kind Flush House Flush Five *Unless holding Four Fingers. Jokers: Splash does not do anything for Stone cards, as they share the same effect.

title: Stone cards
text: Stone cards: *Unless holding Four Fingers. Jokers: Splash does not do anything for Stone cards, as they share the same effect. Blackboard will not be activated if there are Stone cards held in hand.

title: Stone cards
text: Stone cards: Blackboard will not be activated if there are Stone cards held in hand. Strategy: Stone cards are best utilized when playing low scoring poker hands, like High Card or Pair. They can supplement your Chips while your Jokers and hand levels provide Mult. They fall off in scoring potential towards the late game, so they're best used while you look for more Planet cards and scoring Jokers. If playing on the Plasma Deck, Stone cards have a lot more late game potential. While they will eventually be outpaced by Blind scaling, they can easily win you a run with the right setup.

title: Stone cards
text: Stone cards: Trivia: Due to the lack of basic chips, the "+50 Chips" in the Stone cards description is actually extra chips. Therefore, chips granted by Hiker will be directly added to it, rather than a separate "extra chips".

title: Wild cards
text: Wild cards: Wild cards (Enhancement). Type: Enhancement. Effect: Can be used as any suit. Wild cards are playing cards that are Enhanced to count as all Suits simultaneously. This enhancement can be obtained or added to cards a few different ways, including:

title: Wild cards
text: Wild cards: The Lovers adds the Wild enhancement to 1 card in your hand. Incantation, Familiar, and Grim can add Wild Number, Face, and Ace cards, respectively. Standard Packs can contain Wild cards. Illusion allows for Wild cards to be purchased in The Shop. Usage notes: Wild cards will result in the highest tier hand type possible: Playing a hand of will result in a Flush Five being played instead of a Five of a Kind. When a Wild card is debuffed, it reverts back to its base suit. For example: a hand contains 4 Club cards and a debuffed Wild Diamond card does not count as Flush.

title: Wild cards
text: Wild cards: Wild cards do not count for the unlock requirement of having 30 cards of a given suit in your deck, such as for Rough Gem. Similarly, non-heart Wild cards do not need to be played to unlock Shoot the Moon. However, playing Wild 7s (even non-clubs) can unlock Seeing Double. Having 3 Wild cards in the deck will unlock Smeared Joker. Jokers: Since Wild cards count as all suits, any Joker that grants a bonus based on the suit of card, including, but not limited to: Ancient Joker. Castle. Seeing Double. Flower Pot. Blackboard. All Sinful Jokers like Lusty Joker, etc. All Suit-Oriented Jokers like Rough Gem, etc. all benefit from them.

title: Wild cards
text: Wild cards: Blackboard. All Sinful Jokers like Lusty Joker, etc. All Suit-Oriented Jokers like Rough Gem, etc. all benefit from them. Blinds: The Head, The Window, The Club, and The Goad all debuff Wild cards, making them useless when playing hands like Flush, Straight Flush/Royal Flush, Flush House, and Flush Five.

title: Blue Seal
text: Blue Seal: Blue Seal (Seal). Type: Seal. Effect: Creates the Planet card for final played poker hand of round if held in hand, (Must have room). The Blue Seal is a Seal card modifier that, if held in hand, generates a Planet card for the last played Poker Hand of that round. Planet cards will only be created if there is room in your consumable slots, so a maximum of 3 Planet cards can be generated per round if you have Crystal Ball, otherwise the cap is 2. The Blue Seal is one of the best ways to consistently level up a specific Poker Hand.

title: Blue Seal
text: Blue Seal: Acquisition: Trance adds a Blue Seal to 1 selected card. Certificate can create a random playing card with a Blue Seal when the round starts. Standard Packs can contain playing cards with Blue Seals. More cards with Blue Seals can be created with the Death Tarot card and DNA if the player already has at least 1 Blue Seal card in their deck. Usage notes: Blue Seals only generate the Planet card for the final played poker hand of round, which means it is a good idea to estimate the player's hand's strength and see if it can win the Blind, as clearing the Blind with another poker hand will not generate the player's wanted Planet card, wasting a level.

title: Blue Seal
text: Blue Seal: Decks: Magic Deck starts with the Crystal Ball voucher, allowing for up to 3 Planet cards to be generated per round starting at Ante 1. Ghost Deck makes Trance much easier to find. Jokers: Constellation is guaranteed to gain at least X0.1 Mult if you have a Blue Seal in your hand and a consumable slot available. This can go up to X0.3 Mult per round, making this an incredibly powerful combo. Satellite can be upgraded with Blue Seals if your last played Poker Hand is one that has not been leveled up yet. Mime retriggers Blue Seals, giving 2 Planet cards per seal instead of 1. Baron gives X1.5 Mult for each Blue Seal King held in hand.

title: Blue Seal
text: Blue Seal: Baron gives X1.5 Mult for each Blue Seal King held in hand. Reserved Parking has a 1 in 2 chance of giving $1 for each Blue Seal face card held in hand. Perkeo can duplicate the Planet card generated by the Blue Seal, providing considerable XMult when paired with Observatory. Campfire gains X0.25 Mult for every Planet card sold. Vouchers: Crystal Ball allows for up to 3 Planet cards to be made with Blue Seals. Observatory can give up to X3.375 Mult for a specific Poker Hand (not including Negative copies) and Blue Seals are the easiest way to get a specific Planet card into the consumable slots.

title: Blue Seal
text: Blue Seal: Enhancements: Gold cards also trigger if held in hand at the end of the round, giving $3. Steel cards also trigger when held in hand, giving X1.5 Mult. Decks: Nebula Deck removes a consumable slot, making Blue Seals less efficient.

title: Gold Seal
text: Gold Seal: Gold Seal (Seal). Type: Seal. Effect: Earn $3 when this card is played and scores. The Gold Seal is a Seal card modifier that gives $3 if a playing card with this seal is played and scored. A card with a Gold Seal will give an additional $3 per retrigger, and $0 if it is debuffed. This effect is very similar to Gold cards, but awarding money when played rather than when held in hand.

title: Gold Seal
text: Gold Seal: Acquisition: Talisman adds a Gold Seal to 1 selected card. Certificate can create a random playing card with a Gold Seal when the round starts. Standard Packs can contain playing cards with Gold Seals. More cards with Gold Seals can be created with the Death Tarot card and DNA if the player already has at least 1 Gold Seal card in their deck. Strategy: It is recommended to put Gold Seals on cards intended to be played often, and cards that can naturally be retriggered by certain Jokers, like face cards for Sock and Buskin or 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s for Hack.

title: Gold Seal
text: Gold Seal: It is always a good idea to play a Gold Seal card, even if it doesn't contribute much to the score, if the player has spare hands. Losing $1 for playing a hand and gaining at least $3 back is almost always a good trade-off. Jokers: Hanging Chad can retrigger a Gold Seal 2 additional times, providing an extra $6. Sock and Buskin gives an extra $3 per played face card with a Gold Seal. Hack is similar to Sock and Buskin, but applies to 2s, 3s, 4s, and 5s instead. Dusk gives extra money from all scored Gold Seals on the last hand of the round.

title: Gold Seal
text: Gold Seal: Dusk gives extra money from all scored Gold Seals on the last hand of the round. Seltzer gives extra money from all scored Gold Seals for the next 10 hands. Burglar allows for more Gold Seals to be scored in a round. Economy-based scalers, such as Bull, Bootstraps, and Flash Card, appreciate the extra money brought in by Gold Seals. Vouchers: Grabber and Nacho Tong provide more opportunities to score Gold Seals. Enhancements: Stone cards with a Gold Seal can be added to any less than 5 card hand to easily earn $3. Lucky cards with a Gold Seal will give $4.3 on average when played.

title: Gold Seal
text: Gold Seal: Lucky cards with a Gold Seal will give $4.3 on average when played. Anti-Synergies: Vagabond is harder to use as scoring a Gold Seal can bring the player over the $4 barrier, preventing the player from getting a Tarot card on the next hand. Trivia: In versions 0.9.0q-DEMO and earlier Gold Seals used return back to your hand after being played and they used to have a different look, which was used for the seal on Certificate's art and the art for the Completionist achievement.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Purple Seal (Seal). Type: Seal. Effect: Creates a Tarot card when discarded, (Must have room). The Purple Seal is a Seal card modifier that generates a Tarot card once a playing card with this seal is discarded, as long as there is at least one consumable slot available.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Acquisition: Medium adds a Purple Seal to 1 selected card. Certificate can create a random playing card with a Purple Seal when the round starts. Standard Packs can contain playing cards with Purple Seals. More cards with Purple Seals can be created with the Death Tarot card and DNA if the player already has at least 1 Purple Seal card in their deck. Strategy: Counterintuitively, Purple Seals should be put on high value cards. This is because although they incentivize those cards to be discarded, they also incentivize those cards to be duplicated. When many of the duplicated cards are in the deck, they provide far greater value.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Purple Seal cards should also be duplicated with Death with higher priority than other cards, even if the other cards are more powerful. This is because the new Purple Seal cards can be used to generate more Death cards, exponentially increasing the number of Purple Seals and allowing the more powerful cards to be quickly and easily duplicated later in the run. Purple Seals are most powerful to obtain early game, as obtaining one later does not allow it to be duplicated as much, and it will provide far less value. Throwaway hands can be used to dig for Purple Seals without using discards, allowing more to be used per round.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Throwaway hands can be used to dig for Purple Seals without using discards, allowing more to be used per round. Only 2 Purple Seals should be discarded at a time (3 with Crystal Ball or 1 on Nebula Deck) because they only generate a Tarot card if there is room. Decks: Red Deck gives +1 discard, allowing the player to find and make use of Purple Seals. Jokers: Drunkard and Merry Andy provide more discards, allowing the player to find and make use of Purple Seals. The Idol, Bloodstone, Steel Joker, Wee Joker, and many other Jokers benefit from the deck fixing provided by the Tarot cards generated by Purple Seals.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Egg and Gift Card both increase Joker sell value, making the Temperance cards generated from Purple Seals far more valuable. Campfire gains X0.25 Mult for every Tarot card sold. Fortune Teller gains +1 Mult for every Tarot card used. Vampire and Driver's License can turn the enhancements from Tarot cards into permanent XMult. Enhancement Jokers (Stone Joker, Steel Joker, Glass Joker, Golden Ticket, and Lucky Cat) benefit from more Tarot cards that provide their corresponding Enhancement. Blinds: The Hook's discard effect also counts for Purple Seals. Enhancements: Gold cards can be held in hand at the end of the round for $3, and allow the player to get value out of Purple Seal cards even when out of discards.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Glass cards can be duplicated easily early game, and then played late game without worry of breaking, because the player already has so many. Consumables: Death is both created by Purple Seals, and can create more Purple Seals, exponentially increasing the player's ability to deck fix. Temperance can give at most $50, generating considerable amounts of money even without any economy Jokers if Gift Card was used. The Hermit can give at most $20, generating less but still significant amounts of money without any economy Jokers, and with less setup. Vouchers: Wasteful and Recyclomancy grant +1 discard each, making it easier to make use of Purple Seals.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Vouchers: Wasteful and Recyclomancy grant +1 discard each, making it easier to make use of Purple Seals. Crystal Ball increases Consumable slots by 1, allowing for more tarot cards to be created by Purple Seals. Grabber and Nacho Tong grant +1 hand each, allowing the player to use more throwaway hands to find Purple Seals. Decks: Nebula Deck starts with -1 consumable slot, limiting the number of Tarot cards able to be generated by Purple Seals. Blast Off starts with one fewer discard than usual. Jokers: Burglar prevents the player from discarding at all. Ramen, Green Joker, Banner and Delayed Gratification disincentivize discarding.

title: Purple Seal
text: Purple Seal: Jokers: Burglar prevents the player from discarding at all. Ramen, Green Joker, Banner and Delayed Gratification disincentivize discarding. Blinds: The Water starts with 0 discards which means that Purple Seals cannot be used for the round. Stakes: On Blue Stake and higher, having one less discard can make it harder to find and make use of Purple Seals.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Red Seal (Seal). Type: Seal. Effect: Retrigger this card 1 time. The Red Seal is a Seal card modifier that retriggers a playing card with this seal once. The Red Seal retriggers both played and held in hand effects. It is incredibly powerful for Jokers that trigger their effects on playing cards, especially XMult effects.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Acquisition: Deja Vu adds a Red Seal to 1 selected card. Certificate can create a random playing card with a Red Seal when the round starts. Standard Packs can contain playing cards with Red Seals. More cards with Red Seals can be created with the Death Tarot card and DNA if the player already has at least 1 Red Seal card in their deck.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Usage notes: Jokers that retrigger cards like Hack, Mime, or Sock and Buskin will only reactivate the card 1 additional time, and they will not reactivate the Seal a second time. For example, a played Red Seal King will only activate 3 times, once for the initial trigger, once for the Red Seal, and then once more for Sock and Buskin. Red Seals work with both played scoring cards and held in hand cards.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Red Seals work with both played scoring cards and held in hand cards. One of the easiest and most consistent ways to reach Balatro's de facto high score, naneinf, is to make as many Red Seal Steel Kings as possible. This is because with Baron, a Red Seal on a Steel King essentially acts as 2 Steel Kings without a Red Seal. Because each time Baron triggers exponentially increases the score, the player needs to have hundreds of Baron triggers to reach naneinf. While Red Seals are not needed to achieve naneinf this way, it does make it substantially easier.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Face cards are the most versatile cards to have Red Seals on, even if they don't have any Enhancement or Edition. This is because they synergize with Photograph, Triboulet, Baron, Shoot the Moon, Smiley Face, Scary Face, Reserved Parking, and Business Card. Double or Nothing starts with all cards with Red Seals. Decks: Ghost Deck makes finding the Deja Vu card significantly easier. Jokers: Most Jokers benefit from Red Seals, especially those that trigger when certain cards are played. However, some Jokers benefit more from Red Seals than others, such as: Baron will give X2.25 Mult for each Red Seal King held in hand, and ~X5.06 Mult if that King is a Steel card.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Reserved Parking will generally give $0.25 more on average. This can change depending on retriggers and held in hand effects, see the Reserved Parking page for an explanation on the specific interactions and numbers. Bloodstone, The Idol, Ancient Joker, Photograph, and Triboulet all benefit from Red Seals as they give exponentially more Mult the more times their effects are retriggered. Hiker can also permanently add an additional +5 Chips, for a total of a permanent +10 Chips for Red Seal cards. Wee Joker can scale even faster with Red Seal 2 cards and gain +16 Chips, instead of the usual +8 Chips for each scored 2. Modifiers: Steel cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when held in hand.

title: Red Seal
text: Red Seal: Modifiers: Steel cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when held in hand. Gold cards with a Red Seal give $6 if held at the end of the round. With a large hand size, copy effects from Blueprint and/or Brainstorm, retrigger effects from Mime, and Red Seals, it's possible to generate thousands of dollars from this method. Glass cards with a Red Seal give X4 Mult when played, and do not increase the chance of breaking. Polychrome cards with a Red Seal give X2.25 Mult when played.

title: Eternal
text: Eternal: Eternal (Sticker). Type: Sticker. Effect: Can't be sold or destroyed. The Eternal Sticker is a card modifier that prevents the card from being sold or destroyed. Jokers found in the shop or booster packs during Black Stake and higher runs have a 30% chance of getting the Eternal Sticker.

title: Eternal
text: Eternal: A Joker cannot have both the Eternal and Perishable Sticker at the same time. Legendary Jokers will never appear with an Eternal Sticker unless forced to by certain Challenge Decks like Non-Perishable and Typecast.

title: Perishable
text: Perishable: Perishable (Sticker). Type: Sticker. Effect: Debuffed after 5 rounds, (5 remaining). The Perishable Sticker is a card modifier that debuffs the joker after 5 rounds. Jokers found in the shop or booster packs during Orange Stake and higher runs have a 30% chance of getting the Perishable Sticker.

title: Perishable
text: Perishable: A Joker cannot have both the Eternal and Perishable Sticker at the same time. Legendary Jokers are compatible, but have no way to receive the Perishable Sticker.

title: Perishable
text: Perishable: Usage notes: A Debuffed Joker no longer provides any of its original buff nor edition, but still provides passive effects to other Jokers, such as increasing sell value with Gift Card, providing +3 Mult for Abstract Joker or adding its sell value to Swashbuckler or Temperance along with Baseball Card still giving X1.5 Mult for uncommon jokers. Because Perishable Jokers become debuffed after winning the fifth blind but before the Cash Out scene, Jokers that directly give money during Cash Out such as Golden Joker, Cloud 9, etc. will only last 4 rounds instead of 5.

title: Perishable
text: Perishable: Temporary Jokers, such as Popcorn and Turtle Bean, can have the Perishable sticker, even though the sticker generally has no effect on them, due to them disappearing after 5 blinds regardless. Incompatible Jokers: Most non-retroactive positively scaling Jokers (i.e. Jokers with an effect that gradually increases only while the Joker is held) cannot receive the Perishable sticker, which includes the following 18 Jokers: Trivia: Jokers that cannot receive the Perishable Sticker are mostly non-retroactive scaling Jokers (Jokers that always start with a scaling of 0 when picked up). This was because, in playtesting, it was revealed that these Jokers being Perishable often made them useless, as they didn't have time to scale.

title: Rental
text: Rental: Rental (Sticker). Type: Sticker. Effect: Lose $3 at end of round. The Rental Sticker is a card modifier present on Gold Stake that makes Jokers cost $1 to purchase, but deduct $3 at the end of every round. This price is deducted before the round payout.

title: Rental
text: Rental: A Rental Joker can also have an Eternal or Perishable Sticker. All Jokers are compatible with the Rental Sticker, though Legendary Jokers have no way of receiving one. All other Jokers have a 30% chance of spawning with the sticker in the Shop and Booster Packs. Usage notes: If you have less than $3 when a Rental Joker activates, you will be put into debt. If a rental Joker self-destructs (such as Popcorn), it will still charge the $3 as it perishes. Debuffed Jokers (by means of Crimson Heart or the Perishable sticker) still charge $3.

title: Rental
text: Rental: Strategies: Because Rental Jokers cost $1 up-front and sell for $1, they are effectively free if sold before the end of your next round, creating some strategies that are exclusive to Gold stake. Rental Jokers that create value in the shop (such as Hallucination, Chaos the Clown, or Diet Cola), on blind select (such as Cartomancer) or during a blind (such as Mail-In Rebate) can be purchased, then sold before the end of a round for free value. Additionally, the ability to buy and sell a Joker for no effective cost creates free scaling for Campfire. Trivia: When Hologram has a Rental Sticker, the hat of this Joker obscures it, which may catch players by surprise.

title: Stake Stickers
text: Stake Stickers: There are eight different Stake Stickers. These are different from the in-run Stickers. If a Stake Sticker is applied, it will be shown in the top right corner of the card. A Joker or Deck will only show the highest Stake Sticker (from the most difficult stake) that was obtained. Getting a certain Sticker will also automatically unlock all the Stickers below it.

title: Stake Stickers
text: Stake Stickers: A Joker will gain the Sticker corresponding to the Stake of the run, once you beat Ante 8 with this Joker equipped. Jokers that were sold or destroyed before seeing the summary screen or Jokers bought after Ante 8 will not receive a Sticker, but debuffed Jokers (from Crimson Heart or Perishable sticker) do receive Stickers. A Deck similarly will gain the Sticker corresponding to the Stake of the run, once you beat Ante 8 with this Deck.

title: Stake Stickers
text: Stake Stickers: The Stake Stickers can always be seen in the Collection menu, as well as on decks in the "New Run" menu. They are normally not visible on Jokers or Decks during a run, unless the "Display Stake Stickers during Run" setting is enabled. The game also keeps track of how many Stake Stickers you have earned cumulatively for Jokers and Decks. This is found in the Profile menu, under Progress. For Jokers there are 1200 (150 Jokers * 8 Stickers) in total, and for Decks there are 120 (15 Decks * 8 Stickers). Some Achievements make use of these Stickers, such as Completionist++, which requires you to earn a Gold Sticker on every Joker.

title: Stake Stickers
text: Stake Stickers: There are eight Stake Stickers, which are listed here in the same order as their respective Stakes. Trivia: If the "Display Stake Stickers during Run" setting is enabled, the Joker in the intro sequence, win screen, and death screen will have its Stake Sticker visible. In the files of some pre-release versions of the game the Stake Stickers are stars.

title: 15 Minute City
text: 15 Minute City: 15 Minute City (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: None. Initial Jokers & Consumables: Eternal Ride the Bus, Eternal Shortcut. Deck: Two copies of every face card;, no Aces, 2s, or 3s. Restrictions: None. 15 Minute City is a Challenge Deck. It adds a second copy of every face card by replacing all the Aces, 2s and 3s.

title: 15 Minute City
text: 15 Minute City: Starting Contents: The starting jokers are an Eternal Ride the Bus, and an Eternal Shortcut. The starting deck contains 52 cards in total, consisting of 24 face cards (eight Jacks, eight Queens, eight Kings), and 28 non-face cards (four through ten in each of the four suits). Synergies: Due to the way this Challenge is set up, players can opt to two strategies: scale Ride the Bus by playing Straight with number cards, or just focus on building around face cards, which means ignoring the two starting Jokers altogether. Jokers that synergize with the easier to make Straights such as Runner or The Order. Face-card buffing Jokers such as Photograph or Sock and Buskin due to the extra face cards.

title: 15 Minute City
text: 15 Minute City: Face-card buffing Jokers such as Photograph or Sock and Buskin due to the extra face cards. Jokers that rely on specific face cards like Shoot the Moon, Baron, Triboulet or Hit the Road benefit from this deck as well, as they essentially have twice the amount of their required face cards, and (in the case of King- and Queen- based jokers) twice as much lower cards which can be affected with Strength. If one instead chooses to ignore the face cards and just scale the Ride the Bus, Canio will allow you to weed out the face cards while also giving you a massive buff when combined with a reliable way of destroying cards.

title: 15 Minute City
text: 15 Minute City: Anti-Synergies: It is not recommended to use Hack or Fibonacci due to the lack of Aces, 2s and 3s. Similarly, Scholar, Superposition and Wee Joker are downright useless. Joker Stencil caps at X3 Mult in this challenge due to the two starting eternal Jokers. Due to the increased amount of face cards, The Plant and The Mark can become particularly deadly. Pareidolia becomes less valuable in this challenge, as it leaves Ride the Bus useless and the player already has a lot of face cards to begin with.

title: 15 Minute City
text: 15 Minute City: Trivia: The concept of a 15-Minute City is an urban environment where most amenities (such as shops, education, leisure facilities, and healthcare) can be found within a 15-minute walk, cycle, or public transport from your home or where you are. The deck's name could be referring to the nature of using an actual Shortcut or bus (from Ride the Bus) to traverse a city quicker.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Abandoned Deck (Deck). Effect: Start run with no Face Cards in your deck. Unlock Requirement: Win a run with the Green Deck on any difficulty. The Abandoned Deck is an unlockable deck that starts the player off with no face cards. This deck is unlocked by winning a run with the Green Deck on any difficulty.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Starting Contents: The Abandoned Deck contains 40 cards; 4 suits, each with 10 cards (2 to 10 and Ace), missing all the face cards (Kings, Queens, and Jacks) of a standard 52-card deck. This is the lowest starting card count out of any of the non-challenge Decks in the game. Synergies: Because Abandoned starts out with 12 fewer cards and 3 fewer ranks compared to a standard 52-card deck, the player can draw more of the total deck in a round. This advantage can help the player draw aces, suits, and numbered cards more consistently, which in turn gives the Abandoned Deck a lot of synergies.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Poker hands: All poker hands are easier to draw and play due to the smaller deck size. Jokers: The player can draw and discard the rank Mail-In Rebate picks more often because there are 3 fewer ranks than a standard deck, in addition to the smaller deck size. Ride the Bus will almost never reset, as the deck starts out with no face cards. Crazy Joker, Devious Joker, Runner, Superposition, Shortcut, and The Order are all better on Abandoned, as drawing and playing Straights is easier. DNA, Marble Joker, and Certificate all benefit from the lower starting deck size, allowing for the cards created by these Jokers to appear more often.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: In this context, Hologram is also stronger, as adding cards to the deck specifically to scale Hologram is not as punishing as on other decks. Obelisk may be easier to scale further as the player can play more varied Poker Hands. Because the player can draw desired hands to level more often, Burnt Joker may be more useful. Drawing cards the player wants to destroy with Trading Card is easier, and destroying cards makes drawing higher-ranking hands or valuable cards even more consistent. It is also less punishing to use on Blue Stake or higher because the player may still be able to find a desired card more often.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: To Do List is easier to make money from, as the player can play higher-ranking hands without as much difficulty. Jokers that require aces or specific numbered cards are much easier to utilize due to the smaller deck size, these include: Mult Jokers such as Fibonacci and Even Steven. Chips Jokers such as Wee Joker and Odd Todd. Chips and Mult Jokers like Walkie Talkie and Scholar. 8 Ball can be triggered more often due to the player being able to draw and play 8s more consistently. Sixth Sense can trigger more often because drawing and playing 6s is easier. Hack is also easier to use because the player can find the cards it can retrigger more often.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Hack is also easier to use because the player can find the cards it can retrigger more often. Jokers that require the player to play hands containing X of a Kind or Two Pair are easier to trigger due to the smaller size of the deck, these include: Mult Jokers such as Jolly Joker, Zany Joker, and Mad Joker. Chips Jokers such as Sly Joker, Wily Joker, and Clever Joker XMult Jokers such as The Duo, The Trio, and The Family Spare Trousers also has more opportunities to scale. Drawing a specific suit that Ancient Joker wants is significantly easier to do.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Drawing a specific suit that Ancient Joker wants is significantly easier to do. Similarly, other Jokers that require specific suits, like Castle and Gluttonous Joker, are better as drawing a specific suit is much less difficult. Hiker can add bonus chips to the same card more often, as the player can draw it more frequently. Séance may be easier to trigger, as drawing a Straight Flush is possible more often than on other decks. The Idol has fewer options to choose from, making it more useful than on a standard 52-card deck.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: The Idol has fewer options to choose from, making it more useful than on a standard 52-card deck. Consumables: Generally, card modifying consumables, like The Magician and Justice, can be easier to use on Abandoned, as drawing cards the player wants to use those consumables on is more likely in packs and rounds. The Hanged Man and Immolate help further boost the deck thinning it already has. Grim, Familiar, Incantation, and Cryptid are better as the cards added can be drawn more often. Similarly, Ouija may be better as the cards converted can be drawn more frequently, even with the loss of hand size.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Card modifiers: All card modifiers, such as Lucky cards, Gold cards, and Blue Seals, are better since they can be drawn more often. Blinds: The Plant and The Mark are irrelevant as long as the player does not have Pareidolia or has not added many face cards to the deck. Jokers: Blue Joker provides considerably less chips because of the smaller deck size. Erosion only begins scaling below 40 in the deck rather than 52, which can make it more difficult to use to its full potential.

title: Abandoned Deck
text: Abandoned Deck: Jokers that require specific ranks of face cards, such as Shoot the Moon and Triboulet, should be avoided as they are difficult to use, as the player needs a specific rank of face card. Furthermore, Jokers that require face cards, such as Smiley Face and Business Card, should also be avoided unless the player has Pareidolia or has many face cards in the deck. Trivia: The Abandoned Deck is the only starting deck to not initially contain 52 cards, making it the smallest non-challenge deck in the game. An abandoned place usually has few to no people. This deck reflects this by starting with zero face cards.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: Anaglyph Deck (Deck). Effect: After defeating each Boss Blind, gain a Double Tag. Unlock Requirement: Win a run with any deck on the Black Stake difficulty or harder. The Anaglyph Deck is an unlockable deck that gives a Double Tag whenever a Boss Blind is defeated. This deck is unlocked by winning a run on the Black Stake difficulty. This Deck shares an unlock requirement with the Mid Stakes achievement.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: Starting Contents: It contains the 52 cards of a normal deck: four suits, each with 13 cards (2 to 10, Jack, Queen, King and Ace). Jokers: Diet Cola generates another Double Tag, letting you build a bigger stockpile. Throwback can work well with this deck, if you are planning to skip a lot. Bull and Bootstraps can benefit from skip tags that give money, such as Economy Tag and Handy Tag. Hologram can be accelerated by the Standard Tag which can add cards to the deck. Constellation can be accelerated by Meteor Tag. Flash Card can be accelerated by D6 Tag.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: Constellation can be accelerated by Meteor Tag. Flash Card can be accelerated by D6 Tag. Jokers that rely on other Jokers, such as Abstract Joker, Swashbuckler or Baseball Card, can benefit from the Negative Tag. Consumable Jokers like Ice Cream or Popcorn go through fewer hands/rounds when skipping, allowing them to get into more difficult blinds. Tags: Boss Tag should be considered carefully, as it has a chance to reroll into the same Boss Blind when combined with the Double Tags Anaglyph Deck gives, particularly on Ante 8.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: Strategies: Since the Anaglyph Deck will provide the player with many a Double Tag, combined with enough cash or cheap re-rolls, the player can put all of their tags into a single Tag for maximum benefit combined with minimal skips. One example of this is using a Double Tag or multiple on a Negative Tag, as these jokers will not max out your joker slot, the player can be provided with many jokers at no penalization, if the player can source enough cash or is patient enough for further shops. Even if some of the jokers do not benefit the player, there is no harm taking them and they can be sold for profit.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: While it is tempting to focus on tags like Negative Tag and Rare Tag, keep in mind that you need to survive until the next shop (or longer) to see any real benefit while the blinds continue scaling exponentially. Moreover, on higher stakes, many of the jokers generated will be cursed with Perishable or Rental. Some extremely potent alternatives with immediate payoff are the Charm Tag and Ethereal Tag, which provide immediate and immense benefits. The Charm Tag specifically is noteworthy in that the Mega Arcana Packs it generates allow you to choose 2 of 5 tarot cards, giving you many options per pack.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: For example, taking a Charm Tag in ante 5 using the four Double Tags earned so far will enable you to see a total of 25 tarot cards and play 10 of them immediately. To make this more powerful, you can hold tarot cards in your consumable slots (perhaps by activating The Emperor) to block unwanted cards in subsequent packs, and for each card pack, you can activate the more impactful card second, so that if there is a The Fool in the next pack, you can get an extra copy of your preferred card.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: The primary downside to Anaglyph Deck is the rarity of tags worth skipping for, even when multiplied. In the worst-case scenario, a player could find nothing but chaff like Uncommon Tag and Orbital Tag for the wrong hand and Top-up Tag (which is actively worse with several Double Tags stockpiled, as it will unavoidably waste most of them) for all 8 Antes, potentially making Anaglyph Deck have effectively no benefit at all. The only real counter to this is paying close attention to offered tags to ensure something useful is not thoughtlessly passed by.

title: Anaglyph Deck
text: Anaglyph Deck: Trivia: Anaglyph is the method of 3D imagery that relies on seeing the same image twice with two different colour filters - traditionally using red and blue filters, but more recently, using red and cyan filters for better colour - like with cheap 3D glasses. The Anaglyph Deck has the potential to achieve naneinf. By saving 20+ double tags from the deck and Diet Cola, then exchanging all these for Juggle Tags, it is possible to raise the hand size enough to achieve naneinf with a Baron and Mime build.

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Black Deck (Deck). Effect: +1 Joker slot, -1 hand every round. Unlock Requirement: Discover at least 100 items from your collection. The Black Deck is an unlockable Deck that provides +1 Joker slot but -1 Hand each round. This deck is unlocked by discovering at least 100 items in the collection.

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Black Deck is considered by many to be one of the hardest decks the game has to offer. While the upside, +1 Joker slot, is very good going into mid-late game, the brutal -1 Hand each round makes progressing through the first few rounds incredibly difficult, as there will not be many scoring tools available at disposal. The −1 hand also results in one less dollar made at the end of the blind. Starting Contents: It contains the 52 cards of a normal deck: four suits, each with 13 cards (2 to 10, Jack, Queen, King, and Ace).

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Poker Hands: The early game on the Black Deck is much more difficult than with any other deck, since with one less hand, 5 fewer cards can be seen, which makes building around 5-card hands more difficult, but smaller hands (such as High Card) can be even worse, since one can only play 3 of them per round (instead of 4). Jokers: As the Black deck, you should be more willing to take temporary strength, such as Popcorn or Ice Cream, in order to stay alive. Finding an early Riff-Raff can be a very powerful starting Joker as well, leveraging the increased +1 Joker slot for early scoring and econ.

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Some other jokers that benefit from the extra Joker slot or -1 hand per round include: Gros Michel can be good, as it's easier to hold for a long time in order to evolve into Cavendish, and the extra mult is good for surviving the early game. Swashbuckler and Abstract Joker give more flat mult. Joker Stencil gives X6 Mult instead of X5 Mult if all slots are empty, and in general X1 Mult more than the same Joker count on most other decks, making it one of the few ways to benefit from Black Deck's +1 Joker slot without having to acquire a full 6 Jokers. Baseball Card can trigger off of more Uncommon Jokers.

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Baseball Card can trigger off of more Uncommon Jokers. Burglar practically doubles the number of hands you can play. Gift Card increases the sell value of even more Jokers. You are more likely to have an open slot to buy Diet Cola, which you can then sell. Because of the lowered number of hands, Acrobat and Dusk take fewer hands to trigger. Ceremonial Dagger appreciates the extra Joker slot, as one can still have four safe Jokers while scaling Dagger. Effect Jokers that provide no direct scoring, such as Splash, Shortcut or Luchador, become easier to keep thanks to the extra Joker Slot.

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Consumables: Judgement is a good choice, as filling out your Joker slots, even with bad Jokers, can help you survive the early game. The value of Temperance rises from the extra Joker. Vouchers: Grabber and Nacho Tong are incredibly helpful on Black Deck, as they negate the deck's -1 hand penalty. Wasteful and Recyclomancy provide more discards to help assemble powerful hands. Blank / Antimatter can be powerful if you want to go all in on Joker slots. Tags: Top-up Tag grants 2 free Jokers, making it easier to fill the extra Joker slot, especially with Black Deck's weakened economy. Jokers: Jokers that are worse on the Black deck include:

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Jokers: Jokers that are worse on the Black deck include: Overall, any scaling Joker that requires hands to be played is impeded by the -1 hand penalty, giving fewer opportunities to scale them efficiently. This includes Green Joker, Ride the Bus, Supernova, Runner, Square Joker, Spare Trousers, and Obelisk. Jokers that encourage the player to not discard, such as Delayed Gratification, Banner, and Ramen, are very difficult to use, as they suffer from the -1 hand penalty, which forces more dependency on discards while disallowing liberal use of 'throwaway' hands. Vagabond and Reserved Parking suffer from the -1 hand penalty, as Jokers that generate a resource when a hand is played have fewer opportunities to trigger.

title: Black Deck
text: Black Deck: Card Sharp can activate one less time. Loyalty Card becomes harder to activate. Troubadour's -1 hand per round penalty means players will only have 2 hands to beat each blind. Tags: Handy Tag will give less money. Vouchers: Hieroglyph is not recommended, as its -1 hand penalty means the player will only have 2 hands to beat each blind. Trivia: The ability of this deck may be a reference to Negative Jokers (which are usually black), since both give an extra Joker Slot.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Blast Off (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: 2 hands per round, 2 discards per round, 4 Joker Slots. Initial Jokers & Consumables: Eternal Constellation, Eternal Rocket, Planet Merchant, Planet Tycoon. Deck: Standard 52 card deck. Restrictions: Banned Vouchers: Grabber, Nacho Tong, Banned Jokers: Burglar. Blast Off is a Challenge Deck. The Eternal Constellation and Eternal Rocket take up two of the four Joker slots available, and the Rocket can supplement the reduced money from having only two hands per round. The initial vouchers incentivize purchasing Planet cards to build Constellation. The player is unable to gain more hands per round using other means.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Starting Contents: The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards. Jokers: Due to the low amount of hands and starting Discards, players will have to rely on strong + Mult Jokers in the early game and pivot later if they find a good scaling + Mult Joker to go with Constellation: Gros Michel and Mystic Summit are powerful in early Antes, allowing weaker hands to still win in 2 hands at best. Flash Card and Bootstraps are good scaling + Mult Jokers thanks to the increased income from Rocket. Astronomer can help proc the given Constellation, and is doubly helpful with the provided Planet Merchant and Planet Tycoon vouchers.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Astronomer can help proc the given Constellation, and is doubly helpful with the provided Planet Merchant and Planet Tycoon vouchers. Chaos the Clown can help with finding additional Planet cards in the shop, or with finding non-planet cards, though it may need to be replaced for scoring jokers in later antes due to the limited amount of slots. Drunkard and Merry Andy provide extra discards. Dusk and Acrobat can become active very early due to only having 2 hands to play with. Baseball Card can go either way, because although you start with one fewer Joker slot than usual, you also start with 2 Uncommon Jokers.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Vouchers: Clearance Sale and Liquidation can help with purchasing more planet cards and Celestial packs to scale Constellation. Overstock, Overstock Plus, Reroll Surplus, and Reroll Glut all allow the player to see more Planet cards in the shop to scale Constellation. Wasteful and Recyclomancy provide extra discards. Antimatter can offset the -1 Joker slot. Jokers: Abstract Joker, Swashbuckler, and Joker Stencil are weaker in this challenge due to the -1 Joker Slot. Scaling Jokers that require playing lots of hands, like Green Joker, Spare Trousers, or Ride the Bus, are less effective due to the reduced number of hands.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Jokers that encourage the player to not discard such as Delayed Gratification, Banner, and Ramen are much more difficult to use, as they suffer from the -2 hands penalty, which forces much more dependency on discards while disallowing liberal use of 'throwaway' hands. Not only that, but this deck also removes a discard, which makes the former two even worse to use. Vagabond and Reserved Parking suffer from the -2 hands penalty, as Jokers that generate a resource when a hand is played have even fewer opportunities to trigger. Jokers that rely on discarding, such as Castle, Hit the Road, and Mail-In Rebate, are weaker than usual due to the -1 discard.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Card Sharp may only be able to activate once per blind, making it a worse Acrobat. Loyalty Card becomes much harder to activate. Troubadour is very risky to use, as its -1 hand penalty means the player will only have one hand to beat each blind. Fortune Teller becomes harder to scale due to the starting Planet Merchant and Planet Tycoon vouchers, which reduce the probability of Tarot cards appearing in the shop. The same applies to any card that relies on enhanced cards, such as Vampire and Driver's License. Effect Jokers that provide no direct scoring, such as Splash, Shortcut or Luchador, become harder to keep due to the missing Joker Slot.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Tags: Handy Tag and Garbage Tag will give less money due to less hands and discards. Vouchers: Hieroglyph is very risky to use, as its -1 hand penalty means the player will only have one hand to beat each blind. Similarly, Petroglyph is also very risky to use, as its -1 discard penalty means the player will only have one discard. Although items that give discards are not banned, unlike cards that give hands, it is still not recommended since you have to buy Hieroglyph first, which means only one hand per round. Consumables: Temperance will give less money due to the player only having 4 Jokers slots.

title: Blast Off
text: Blast Off: Consumables: Temperance will give less money due to the player only having 4 Jokers slots. Blinds: Due to the low amount of hands and discards, The Needle and The Water can be particularly deadly. Trivia: The term "blast off" means a rocket or another type of spacecraft launching from its base site and into outer space, which references the Rocket being one of the jokers you start with.

title: Blue Deck
text: Blue Deck: Blue Deck (Deck). Effect: +1 hand every round. Unlock Requirement: Discover at least 20 items from your collection. The Blue Deck is an unlockable deck which provides +1 hand every round. This deck is unlocked by discovering at least 20 items in the collection.

title: Blue Deck
text: Blue Deck: Starting Contents: It contains the 52 cards of a normal deck: four suits, each with 13 cards (2 to 10, Jack, Queen, King and Ace). Synergies: Starting with 5 hands instead of the default 4, gives two main advantages: If this extra hand is unused, it gives $1 more during payout. If used, this hand can provide extra score, or be used to find a more favorable hand. As a sidenote, this almost always makes having +1 hand better than +1 discard (as with Red Deck), as hands can literally be used like discards, but they give score (and can still be unused to give $1 at payout). The exception is with specific synergies like Delayed Gratification and Yorick.

title: Blue Deck
text: Blue Deck: Jokers: Almost all scaling Jokers benefit from having a lot of hands, such as Green Joker, Wee Joker, or Square Joker, as they can be scaled more. Troubadour's -1 Hand has less of an effect. Card Sharp: The extra hand allows more possible hands to be played with the X3 Mult active. Loyalty Card becomes easier to activate. Space Joker: The extra hand gives more opportunities for Space Joker to activate. Hiker: The extra hand allows more cards to be played and upgraded. Vagabond: Allows for the generation of 1 more Tarot card per Blind. Reserved Parking and Matador: the extra hand allows for the generation of more money. Tags: Handy Tag can provide extra money.

title: Blue Deck
text: Blue Deck: Tags: Handy Tag can provide extra money. Vouchers: Hieroglyph: Helps make up for Hieroglyph's -1 Hand downside. Blinds: The Needle nullifies Blue Deck's +1 hand. Trivia: Red and Blue backed playing card decks are some of the most common colors used in real-world playing card decks, such as Bicycle decks.

title: Bram Poker
text: Bram Poker: Bram Poker (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: Jokers no longer appear in the shop. Initial Jokers & Consumables: Eternal Vampire, The Emperor, The Empress, Magic Trick, Illusion. Deck: Standard 52 card deck. Restrictions: None. Bram Poker is a Challenge Deck. While playing this challenge, jokers no longer appear in the Shop, meaning players will have to rely on scaling with the starting eternal Vampire using card enhancements and Planet cards. Note that Jokers can still be acquired via Judgement, Booster Packs, and tags that spawn Jokers in the Shop.

title: Bram Poker
text: Bram Poker: Starting Contents: The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards, an eternal Vampire, and the Tarot cards The Emperor and The Empress. The Vouchers Magic Trick and Illusion have also been redeemed. Synergies: Because Vampire requires a large amount of Enhanced cards to remove enhancements from, a strong economy and Tarot card supply are needed to beat this challenge. This includes: Any economy, like Golden Joker, Rocket, or Cloud 9. Tarot-generating Jokers like 8 Ball, Superposition, Cartomancer, or Vagabond. Midas Mask can be a great addition, as it can help scale Vampire much faster. As the player needs to rely on Tarot cards, Fortune Teller can be a good pickup.

title: Bram Poker
text: Bram Poker: As the player needs to rely on Tarot cards, Fortune Teller can be a good pickup. Since the player starts with Magic Trick, Hologram and Blue Joker will scale much faster. Sixth Sense and Séance can be used to create Wraith. The Uncommon Tag and Rare Tag tags allow additional Jokers to spawn in the Shop, which can be combined with the Foil Tag, Holographic Tag, Polychrome Tag, and Negative Tag to enhance them. If there are no Buffoon Packs in the Shop after a while, it might be worthwhile to skip blinds for these Tags if players are desperately in need of more Jokers.

title: Bram Poker
text: Bram Poker: The Top-up Tag and Buffoon Tag can also be used, but they cannot be combined with the Edition tags. Clearance Sale and Liquidation can help with the cost of Arcana Packs, Tarot cards, and playing cards. Tarot Merchant and Tarot Tycoon will make it more likely for Tarot cards to appear to scale Vampire. It also makes Judgement appear more often to get more Jokers. Anti-Synergies: While not straight-up useless, Showman is significantly less useful due to Jokers no longer appearing in the Shop. Jokers that rely on specific card enhancements like Lucky Cat, Glass Joker, and Golden Ticket are basically useless, as it will be hard for the player to hold on to enhanced playing cards.

title: Bram Poker
text: Bram Poker: Driver's License becomes impossible to use, as it limits the player not to play any enhanced cards in order to stay activated. While not directly useless, any Joker that benefits from Planet cards, such as Constellation, Astronomer or Satellite, are harder to use since Planet cards don't do a lot with Vampire. Trivia: Bram Poker is a pun on the name of Irish author Bram Stoker, famously known for his 1897 novel Dracula, which popularised vampires outside Transylvanian folklore, and invented the idea of vampires transforming into bats and their weaknesses to garlic, crucifixes, and sunlight. This is the only challenge deck that starts with consumables.

title: Challenge Decks
text: Challenge Decks: Challenge Decks (Deck). Effect: Limitation varies per deck. Unlock Requirement: Challenge Mode is unlocked by winning a regular run with five different decks. Challenge Decks are unique decks that contain some condition making them unique from, and often more challenging than, the normal decks. This could manifest in having an altered starting deck, possessing certain Eternal Jokers, restrictions on hands or discards, restrictions on allowed cards, and more. They can only be played on the White Stake.

title: Challenge Decks
text: Challenge Decks: When playing Challenge Decks, achievements and unlocks cannot be obtained, as some would be trivialized by the conditions given by the deck. Statistics such as the number of times a consumable has been used and high scores like Best Hand/Highest Ante still get updated. It is not possible to start a seeded run on Challenge Decks, but the seed generated by each challenge run can still be used on normal decks.

title: Challenge Decks
text: Challenge Decks: Decks: There are twenty different Challenge Decks currently in Balatro, with the first five unlocked after winning on five different decks. Each subsequent deck is unlocked after winning a run with a new Challenge Deck. To unlock all the Challenge Decks, the player needs to win with fifteen of them. Trivia: The card back of the Challenge Deck is a maze. The maze can be started either from the top opening or the bottom one. LocalThunk, the developer of Balatro, has stated that some manner of challenge creator is on his list of things to add, with no timetable.

title: Challenge Decks
text: Challenge Decks: If a Challenge begins with a Voucher, and a saved run is continued from the main menu before the first Blind is selected, any effect the Voucher would have will not be applied.

title: Checkered Deck
text: Checkered Deck: Checkered Deck (Deck). Effect: Start run with 26 Spades and 26 Hearts in deck. Unlock Requirement: Win a run with the Black Deck on any difficulty. The Checkered Deck replaces each Club with a Spade of the same rank, and each Diamond with a Heart of the same rank. This means for each rank, there will be two Spades, and two Hearts. It can be unlocked by winning a run with the Black Deck on any difficulty.

title: Checkered Deck
text: Checkered Deck: Starting Contents: The Checkered Deck starts with 52 cards, consisting of two Spade cards and two Heart cards for every rank. Poker hands: Flush, Straight Flush, and Flush House are easier to draw and play with this deck. Jokers: This Deck works best with Jokers that boost Heart and Spade cards, along with Jokers that reward flushes. Lusty Joker boosts Heart Mult. Wrathful Joker boosts Spade Mult. Bloodstone gives Heart cards a 1 in 2 chance of gaining X1.5 Mult when scored. Arrowhead gives Spade cards +50 Chips when scored. Droll Joker, Crafty Joker, and The Tribe boost Flushes. Juggler and Troubadour increase hand size, ensuring there will always be a Flush available to play. Shortcut makes Straight Flushes easier.

title: Checkered Deck
text: Checkered Deck: Shortcut makes Straight Flushes easier. Four Fingers makes Flushes and Straights require only 4 cards, and additionally makes Straight Flushes significantly easier to play; allowing you to meet the requirements for both a Straight and a Flush in 5 cards (such as 9♠️ 8♠️ 7♥️ 6♠️ 3♠️). Séance creates a Spectral card when a Straight Flush is played. Castle scales twice as much due to the reduced number of suits in the deck. The Idol will often choose a playing card that you have 2 of. Vouchers: Paint Brush allows a Flush to be made each time a hand is drawn, as long as no Club, Diamond, or Stone cards have been added to the deck.

title: Checkered Deck
text: Checkered Deck: Boss Blinds: The Club and The Window are irrelevant as long as the player doesn't add any Club, Diamond, or Wild cards or has Smeared Joker. Jokers: In general, Jokers that boost Clubs/ Diamonds are less useful on Checkered Deck. Smeared Joker can allow Club/ Diamond-focused Jokers to be useful, but is generally still not recommended due to taking up a Joker slot and making this deck weak against The Club and The Window, which otherwise would do nothing. Gluttonous Joker, Greedy Joker, Onyx Agate and Rough Gem have less value due to the lack of Clubs and Diamonds. Similarly, Seeing Double is useless due to the lack of Clubs.

title: Checkered Deck
text: Checkered Deck: Similarly, Seeing Double is useless due to the lack of Clubs. Ancient Joker always picks a random suit, even if the suit is not in the deck. Flower Pot is useless without Clubs and Diamonds. Be careful when using Certificate, as it can create Club and Diamond cards, making it harder to play flushes. Consumables: Sigil can still transform cards into Clubs and Diamonds, which defeats the whole point of the deck. The Moon and The Star transform cards into Clubs and Diamonds respectively, which can make them awkward to use. Boss Blinds: The Head and The Goad are more deadly.

title: Checkered Deck
text: Checkered Deck: Boss Blinds: The Head and The Goad are more deadly. Trivia: The Checkered Deck's design seem to be inspired by Checkers, which is typically played on a black and red board with black and red pieces. In other media: In Vampire Survivors, there is a stage called "Ante Chamber", where a part of that stage uses floor tiles that have the same pattern as the Checkered Deck.

title: Cruelty
text: Cruelty: Cruelty (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: Small Blinds give no reward money, Big Blinds give no reward money,, 3 Joker Slots. Initial Jokers & Consumables: None. Deck: Standard 52 card deck. Restrictions: None. Cruelty is a Challenge Deck. It gives the player only 3 Joker Slots, and the Small Blind/ Big Blind no longer give any reward money.

title: Cruelty
text: Cruelty: Starting Contents: The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards. Synergies: Due to the -2 Joker slots penalty and very low econ, only several specific builds can clear this challenge. Econ Jokers like Golden Joker, Cloud 9, or Rocket are a good pickup early on to quickly build up to the max interest threshold. Scaling Jokers like Square Joker, Supernova, or Constellation can provide increasing sources of Chips, Mult, and XMult, and make the best use of the limited Joker slots. With limited Joker slots, being able to scale, generate value, and score without Jokers is more important: Blue Seals provide the most consistent source of scaling without Jokers. Purple Seals provide a source of Tarot cards without Jokers.

title: Cruelty
text: Cruelty: Purple Seals provide a source of Tarot cards without Jokers. Gold cards and Gold Seals provide one of the only ways to gain more money without economy Jokers. Steel cards provide a consistent way to score more without Jokers. Glass cards provides both a way to deck fix by breaking cards early, a quick way to score more in tough Boss Blinds or when Antes scale too quickly, and an incredibly powerful source of XMult late game. Red Seals synergize with both Gold cards, Steel cards, and Glass cards. Telescope and Observatory provide consistent scaling, and X1.5 Mult per planet card held in the consumable area respectively. The Negative Tag can provide extra Jokers.

title: Cruelty
text: Cruelty: The Negative Tag can provide extra Jokers. Antimatter can provide an extra Joker slot without the need of any Negative Jokers. Jokers: As there are only 3 Joker slots, Joker Stencil can only provide a maximum of X3 Mult. Similarly, Abstract Joker and Swashbuckler will be weaker as fewer Jokers can be acquired. As econ is lower during earlier antes, Bull and Bootstraps will be harder to scale without other income sources. Other Jokers that rely on money to scale, like Flash Card and Ceremonial Dagger, are also more difficult to scale early game. Riff-Raff is more difficult to use with fewer slots free for new Jokers.

title: Cruelty
text: Cruelty: Riff-Raff is more difficult to use with fewer slots free for new Jokers. Gift Card is less powerful with 2 fewer Jokers for it to increase the sell value of. Baseball Card is less powerful with 2 fewer possible Uncommon Jokers to gain X1.5 Mult. Effect Jokers that provide no direct scoring, such as Splash, Shortcut or Luchador, become much harder to keep due to 2 missing Joker Slots. Consumables: Temperance will give less money due to the player only having 3 Jokers slots.

title: Cruelty
text: Cruelty: Consumables: Temperance will give less money due to the player only having 3 Jokers slots. Trivia: In law terms, cruelty is behaviour which causes physical or mental harm to another, especially a spouse, whether intentionally or not. Having low econ on the beginning and being limited to 3 Joker Slots can be "cruelty" against the player.

title: Double or Nothing
text: Double or Nothing: Double or Nothing (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: All Played cards become debuffed after scoring. Initial Jokers & Consumables: None. Deck: Standard 52-card deck, all with a Red Seal. Restrictions: None. Double or Nothing is a Challenge Deck. All cards played will be debuffed after scoring.

title: Double or Nothing
text: Double or Nothing: Starting Contents: The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards, and each has a Red Seal. Usage Notes: If you play a hand that is disallowed by a Boss Blind (like The Eye) the hand's scoring cards will still be debuffed. Jokers that depend on the total number of cards in a deck (like Cloud 9) still count debuffed cards as normal. Copies created by DNA will retain the original's debuff status from before play. Synergies: Jokers that award chips and mult after each card is scored, rather than during, are preferred. Matador is a very good econ source, as playing any debuffed card will reward players $8, even during Small and Big Blind.

title: Double or Nothing
text: Double or Nothing: By using Planet cards you can increase the score of the poker hand itself, instead of needing to rely on the cards that are played. Jokers that proc independently of the debuffed played cards can also work. For example, + Mult Jokers like Spare Trousers, Bootstraps, etc. can be scaled without the played cards needing to be buffed. Jokers that care about cards in hand like Baron or Shoot the Moon will be doubly effective as the Red Seals will make them trigger twice, as long as they haven't been debuffed. Steel cards are similarly doubly effective. Mime will pair well with this as well, since it will retrigger the cards held in hand.

title: Double or Nothing
text: Double or Nothing: Mime will pair well with this as well, since it will retrigger the cards held in hand. The Devil can also create Gold cards which will give you an extra $3, with the Red Seal. Using Tarot cards to give an enhancement to debuffed cards will revive them, so any good source of Tarot generating is recommended, be it Cartomancer, Superposition, Vagabond or 8 Ball. This does not include Strength, suit changing tarot cards like The Sun, Aura or seal adding cards like Trance since they do not give enhancements.

title: Double or Nothing
text: Double or Nothing: Anti-Synergies: Using bigger Poker hands like a Flush or Straight means that more of your cards will become debuffed. By using smaller Poker hands like High Card or Pair, you will not have to worry about this as much. Splash may result in an excessive amount of cards being debuffed. Jokers that rely on specific cards needing to be played, since they will become debuffed afterwards (unless you can enhance them with a Tarot card). This includes: Fibonacci, Wee Joker, Hack, Smiley Face, etc.

title: Double or Nothing
text: Double or Nothing: This includes: Fibonacci, Wee Joker, Hack, Smiley Face, etc. Deja Vu loses a lot of value, since the starting deck already has 52 Red Seals; if more are needed, it's likely more practical to revive a debuffed card with an enhancer Tarot than to use Deja Vu. Hiker relies on playing the same cards repeatedly, which is impractical when they get debuffed every time. Trivia: The term "double or nothing" is usually used in gambling games like poker, where someone can choose to either keep their prize, or try again to gain the double, with the risk of losing it all.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Erratic Deck (Deck). Effect: All Ranks and Suits in deck are randomized. Unlock Requirement: Win a run with any deck on the Orange Stake difficulty or harder. The Erratic Deck is an unlockable deck which randomizes the rank and suit of the starting 52 playing cards. This deck is unlocked by winning a run on any deck on the Orange Stake difficulty or harder.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Starting Contents: This deck contains 52 cards like a normal deck, but the suits and ranks of each card are completely randomized. If sorted by their frequency, we get on average the following distribution: Synergies: There is no 'correct' strategy with this deck as it is different on every run - you should check the Full Deck at the beginning before buying any Jokers or consumables. A deck with many of one or two suits may be best approached with Flushes, or a deck with lots of the same rank of card may be best suited to Three/Four/Five of a Kind hands or Full House if more than one is common.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Mathematically, drawing cards from Erratic Deck is equivalent to performing a sampling with replacement from a standard deck (e.g., the probability of drawing a heart is always 1/4, unaffected by any of the already drawn cards). Therefore, in general, the probability of drawing a Flush or multiple same-ranked cards in a X of a Kind with Erratic Deck is higher than other decks, while the probability of drawing a Straight, Straight Flush, and a High Card of 5 cards is lower compared to other decks. Additionally, secret hands may not require deck manipulation to appear in Erratic Deck. Jokers: Due to the uneven suit and rank distribution Castle, The Idol and Mail-In Rebate are all stronger.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Jokers: Due to the uneven suit and rank distribution Castle, The Idol and Mail-In Rebate are all stronger. DNA can inflate specific ranks/suits even further, which can allow the player to play higher ranking hands more consistently. Hiker can add more bonus chips to more cards because higher ranking hands can be played more often, allowing more cards to be scored. Jokers that require the player to play hands containing X of a Kind or Two Pair are easier to trigger due to the randomness of the deck, these include: Mult Jokers such as Jolly Joker, Zany Joker and Mad Joker. Chips Jokers such as Sly Joker, Wily Joker and Clever Joker

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Chips Jokers such as Sly Joker, Wily Joker and Clever Joker XMult Jokers such as The Duo, The Trio and The Family Spare Trousers also has more opportunities to scale. To Do List can be easier to activate, as more varied poker hands can be played without as much difficulty, this may allow the player to gain value from To Do List more often. Jokers that require specific ranks, like Baron and Walkie Talkie, can be easier to utilize in some Erratic seeds. Similarly, other Jokers that require specific suits, like Rough Gem and Lusty Joker, can be utilized more in some seeds.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Similarly, other Jokers that require specific suits, like Rough Gem and Lusty Joker, can be utilized more in some seeds. Consumables: Death, Strength, Cryptid and Suit Modifiers can all inflate specific ranks and suits, which can help further boost the uneven deck distribution Erratic already has. Grim or Familiar may be useful if the deck generates with many Aces or Face Cards respectively. Jokers: Crazy Joker, Devious Joker, The Order, Superposition and Runner are all significantly harder to use as Straights are much harder to make. Shortcut is harder to use because Erratic makes Straights a less viable hand to play around.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: Shortcut is harder to use because Erratic makes Straights a less viable hand to play around. Similarly Four Fingers is harder for the same reason, and the uneven deck may allow the player to make Flushes without needing Four Fingers. Ancient Joker is harder to use because the deck may have uneven suit distribution, making finding Flushes of suits Ancient wants harder. Séance is much harder to activate as Straight Flush is considerably harder to play. Trivia: There appears to be no pattern to the symbols or their colors on the card design. This decks art used to be more vibrant in pre-release versions.

title: Erratic Deck
text: Erratic Deck: This decks art used to be more vibrant in pre-release versions. If you use the seed "7LB2WVPK" with the Erratic Deck, you will get a deck made purely of 10 of Spades. This can be taken one step further with the seed "XEQH7CP9", which as well as having only 10 of Spades also has exclusively holographic jokers until Ante 10. These seeds are RNG bugs, not a true random deck; the probability of randomly generating 52 of the same card without such a bug is 1 in 3.282e87, while there are only 2.318e12 valid seeds, so it is virtually certain that no seed does so naturally.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Five-Card Draw (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: 6 discards per round, 5 hand size, 7 Joker slots. Initial Jokers & Consumables: Card Sharp, Joker. Deck: Standard 52 card deck. Restrictions: Banned Jokers: Juggler, Troubadour, Turtle Bean. Five-Card Draw is a Challenge Deck. Its small hand size can be supplemented by the additional discards in order to find and play the same hand multiple times.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Starting Contents: The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards. Poker hands: Due to the limited hand size that comes with this deck, builds focused on playing poker hands that are very easy to formulate like High Card or Pair are practically required when trying to beat this challenge deck, and tend to be more reliable than ones centered on larger hands such as Flush or Full House. These types of hands are also encouraged by Card Sharp (which is provided to the player initially), as Card Sharp becomes easier to trigger when easier hands are played. Jokers: Generic + Mult Jokers like Half Joker and Gros Michel can help you push through the early antes.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Jokers: Generic + Mult Jokers like Half Joker and Gros Michel can help you push through the early antes. Jokers that benefit from the extra Joker slots, like Abstract Joker, Riff-Raff, and Joker Stencil. Jokers that benefit from the extra discards, like Banner and Delayed Gratification. Square Joker is much more viable on this deck, and can act as a good source of chips to bolster lower poker hands like High Card or Pair. Blackboard becomes practically guaranteed to activate, due to the small hand size and additional discards. Strong XMult Jokers that aren't reliant on hand type, such as Hologram, Constellation, and Cavendish. Blue Joker gives slightly more chips due to drawing fewer cards from your deck.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Blue Joker gives slightly more chips due to drawing fewer cards from your deck. Yorick is amazing in this challenge, as the increased discards mean it can consistently gain X1 Mult every blind with the use of 5 discards. Raised Fist is more likely to have a better score from the reduced hand size, as it's easier to hold onto high-ranked cards. It's important to note that this Joker won't provide any scoring if all cards in hand are played. Effect Jokers that provide no direct scoring, such as Splash, Shortcut or Luchador, become easier to keep thanks to the extra 2 Joker Slots.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Vouchers: Paint Brush and Palette can be used to increase your hand size in this challenge, to a maximum of 7 cards. Tags: Juggle Tag can give a temporary hand size boost for the player. This can help in certain situations where the player might want to see more of their deck. Garbage Tag will give more money for unused discards. Consumables: The value of Temperance rises from two extra Jokers. Boss Blinds: The House becomes less deadly, since only 5 cards are drawn face down. The Serpent can also temporarily increase the player's hand size, allowing them to see more of their deck at once.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: The Serpent can also temporarily increase the player's hand size, allowing them to see more of their deck at once. Jokers: Held in hand effects such as Baron and Shoot the Moon are less effective due to the decreased hand size and banning of hand size-increasing Jokers. The lower hand size of this deck makes Mime applicable in less situations, although it is not totally unviable due to its interaction with Raised Fist. Straight-based Jokers, such as Runner, Crazy Joker, and The Order, becomes much harder to use due to the decreased hand size, which makes it extremely hard to assemble Straights.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: On a similar note, Séance requires playing a Straight Flush, which is effectively impossible with a hand size of 5. Hand size reducing Jokers like Stuntman and Merry Andy can potentially be harmful, as their reduced hand size penalty will make it harder to play larger poker hands. However, Stuntman can provide a valuable source of chips in the early game. Burglar can sometimes be unhelpful, as its 3 extra hands at times do not benefit as much as the 3 extra discards already provided by this challenge will. Green Joker and Ramen do not benefit too much from the extra discards.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Green Joker and Ramen do not benefit too much from the extra discards. Consumables: Ectoplasm probably shouldn't be used unless in some specific scenarios, as its permanent hand size reduction can make even easy hands like Pair harder to assemble, and the player already has 2 extra Joker Slots, therefore making it less valuable. Sigil and Ouija will transform fewer cards due to the small hand size. Not only that, but Ouija also reduces hand size, making it significantly more punishing to use. The Devil, The Chariot and Trance become weaker, for reasons stated below. Modifiers: The decreased hand size doesn't allow many Gold cards, Steel cards, and Blue Seals to be utilized.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Modifiers: The decreased hand size doesn't allow many Gold cards, Steel cards, and Blue Seals to be utilized. Blinds: The Manacle's reduced hand size can be dangerous, if the player is playing towards more complex poker hands. If the player reduces hand size even by one (assuming they didn't redeem Paint Brush), The Psychic will become unbeatable. If the player relies on discards for scoring or drawing a hand, The Water can be a problem. The Eye's condition of no duplicate hand types can be difficult to accomplish, since only High Card and Pair are easy to draw. This issue is compounded by the fact that the challenge pushes the player towards Card Sharp by providing it at the start.

title: Five-Card Draw
text: Five-Card Draw: Trivia: Five-Card Draw brings Balatro closer to the popular poker variant of the same name, where players are dealt five cards in their hand and are able to discard and replace many of these easily.

title: Fragile
text:
Fragile: Fragile (Deck). Rules & Modifiers: None. Initial Jokers & Consumables: 2x Eternal, Negative Oops! All 6s. Deck: Standard 52-card deck, all glass. Restrictions: All methods of adding non-glass cards or removing glass enhancements are banned:
 Jokers: Marble Joker, Vampire, Midas Mask and Certificate 
 Tarot cards: The Magician, The Empress, The Hierophant, The Chariot, The Devil, The Tower, and The Lovers 
 Spectral cards: Incantation, Grim, and Familiar 
 Vouchers: Magic Trick and Illusion 
 Booster Packs: All Standard Pack s 
 Tags: Standard Tag. Fragile is a Challenge Deck. It comes with all Glass cards and two Eternal, Negative Oops! All 6s, ensuring that every Glass card is broken upon being played. Additionally, any way of adding or modifying playing cards is banned. As the game ends when all cards are gone, care should be taken to avoid breaking every card.

title: Fragile
text: Fragile: Starting Contents: The starting deck contains the standard 52 cards, and each one is Glass. Usage notes: Even though Incantation is banned, it can still appear if all others Spectral cards are owned and the player doesn't have Showman. Cards debuffed by a boss blind will not break when played, allowing them to be strategically carried to successive antes. Synergies: Cryptid is still allowed in order to duplicate the Glass cards the player already has in their deck. Glass Joker will build reliably throughout the challenge. Canio can gain X1 Mult for each destroyed face card, which would activate for every played scoring face card in this challenge.

title: Fragile
text: Fragile: Driver's License will immediately provide X3 Mult, though it could expire if the player's deck is reduced to 15 or fewer cards. Erosion gains mult similarly throughout the run. It is weaker than Glass Joker, however, because its additive mult comes into play after the Glass cards are used. Abstract Joker can get an extra +6 Mult with the two negative Oops! All 6s. Gros Michel will be much likelier to go extinct with the two Oops! All 6s, so you can get Cavendish much faster for a flat X3 Mult. Half Joker can be beneficial as well, since you want to play smaller poker hands.

title: Fragile
text: Fragile: Half Joker can be beneficial as well, since you want to play smaller poker hands. Burnt Joker will help you level up your poker hands quickly since you want to play smaller hands like High Card or Pair. This means you can draw it much easier to discard for Burnt Joker. Throwback provides a good scaling XMult source, as players are encouraged to skip blinds to preserve as many Glass cards as possible to beat Ante 8. Retriggers such as Hanging Chad, Sock and Buskin, and Seltzer allow Glass cards to become far more powerful. Space Joker and 8 Ball are guaranteed to hit, which is useful to level up played hands or spawn Tarot cards.

title: Fragile
