text: Orange Stake: Winning a run on this Stake with a specific Deck will result in unlocking the succeeding Stake on that Deck, the Gold Stake. Winning a run with this Stake for the first time will make the player unlock the Erratic Deck.

title: Purple Stake
text: Purple Stake: Purple Stake (Stake). Description: Required score scales faster for each Ante. Previous: Blue Stake. Next: Orange Stake. The Purple Stake is the sixth Stake, being unlocked after winning Blue Stake on a specific Deck. Like the Green Stake, this Stake scales up the score requirements for defeating Blinds for each Ante. Furthermore, it also applies the effects of all preceding Stakes.

title: Purple Stake
text: Purple Stake: Winning a run on this Stake with a specific Deck will result in unlocking the succeeding Stake on that Deck, the Orange Stake. Trivia: It is one of the three stakes that do not unlock a Deck upon winning, with the other two being the White Stake and the Gold Stake.

title: Red Stake
text: Red Stake: Red Stake (Stake). Description: Small Blind gives no reward money. Unlocked Deck on win: Zodiac Deck. Previous: White Stake. Next: Green Stake. The Red Stake is the second Stake, being unlocked after winning White Stake on a specific Deck. This Stake makes the player earn no money specifically from defeating the Small Blind.

title: Red Stake
text: Red Stake: Winning a run on this Stake with a specific Deck will result in unlocking the succeeding Stake on that Deck, the Green Stake. Winning a run with this Stake for the first time will complete the achievement Low Stakes and unlock the Zodiac Deck.

title: White Stake
text: White Stake: White Stake (Stake). Description: Base difficulty. Next: Red Stake. The White Stake is the first Stake that all players start with in Balatro. This stake has no effects.

title: White Stake
text: White Stake: Winning a run on this Stake with a specific Deck will unlock Red Stake on that Deck. Trivia: It is one of the three stakes that do not unlock a Deck upon winning, with the other two being the Purple Stake and the Gold Stake. Since Blueprint requires winning a run (in White Stake), it can be said that the White Stake indirectly unlocks the Blueprint.

title: Amber Acorn
text: Amber Acorn: Amber Acorn (Blind). Type: Showdown. Description: Flips and shuffles all Joker cards. Minimum Ante: 8. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 8. Matador: ✗ No. Amber Acorn is a showdown blind that flips all of the Jokers in possession so that they are face down and then they are shuffled into random positions in the joker panel.

title: Amber Acorn
text: Amber Acorn: Usage notes: The Jokerless challenge bans Amber Acorn. This is likely because there wouldn't be any Jokers for it to shuffle, meaning its effect would be rendered obsolete, making it just a normal Blind with a 2x base Blind size. Strategies: The player should carefully note as to what Jokers are triggered. If they have a Joker with XMult in possession, they should be moved to the right side of the panel to maximize the score. Lowering the game's speed in the settings may help with paying closer attention to the triggered Jokers. There are four Jokers which can still be distinguished while face down due to their unique shape, being the Square Joker, Half Joker, Wee Joker and Photograph.

title: Amber Acorn
text: Amber Acorn: If the player manages to grab and hold one of their Jokers right after they select the blind but before their Jokers are shuffled, said Joker will still be flipped, however it won't be shuffled. This allows the player to begin the blind while already knowing the position of one of their Jokers. Jokers like DNA, Trading Card, and Loyalty Card are easy to locate as they still shake when their respective conditions are met. When a Joker that was made as a copy through Ankh or Invisible Joker gets flipped by Amber Acorn, the back of the card will show as a Red Deck card.

title: Amber Acorn
text: Amber Acorn: The selling prices of Face down Jokers are displayed as "$?", so it's impossible to distinguish them from each other through this. However, on Black Stake difficulty or higher (and in some Challenges), flipped Eternal Jokers will have their price tag grayed out when selected. This can help the player narrow down or even pinpoint certain Jokers. During Amber Acorn, Ceremonial Dagger will take effect between flipping and shuffling, so it will still destroy the Joker on the right side (rather than randomly one). Trivia: Acorns are a suit in German decks, replacing Clubs. When Chicot is owned, Amber Acorn will first shuffle all cards and then get disabled by Chicot. This is the only boss blind with this feature.

title: Big Blind
text: Big Blind: Big Blind (Blind). Type: Standard. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 1.5x base. Reward: 4. Matador: ✗ No. The Big Blind is the second Blind of each ante. It can be skipped to receive a Tag. The Big Blind has a base chip requirement multiplier of X1.5. Defeating the Big Blind will always reward $4 upon defeating it, unless Blind payouts have been disabled by one of the two Challenge Decks (which are The Omelette and Cruelty).

title: Big Blind
text: Big Blind: In other media: The Big Blind makes an appearance as a boss enemy in Vampire Survivors.

title: Cerulean Bell
text: Cerulean Bell: Cerulean Bell (Blind). Type: Showdown. Description: Forces 1 card to always be selected. Minimum Ante: 8. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 8. Matador: ✗ No. Cerulean Bell is a Showdown Blind that forces a random playing card to always be selected. If there's no force-selected card in the player's hand after playing or discarding, a new random playing card will be chosen.

title: Cerulean Bell
text: Cerulean Bell: Strategies: The Hanged Man is a great way to deselect the card by destroying it, letting the player freely select other cards for the given hand. Smaller poker hands like Pair may have an easier time with this blind, since non-scoring cards that are selected will have no effect on your played hands. Interactions: The Hanged Man can be used to destroy the force-selected card. When using Death, if the card selected by Cerulean Bell is: On the right side, converting a different card into the force-selected card, then both cards cannot be deselected afterwards.

title: Cerulean Bell
text: Cerulean Bell: On the right side, converting a different card into the force-selected card, then both cards cannot be deselected afterwards. On the left side, converting the force-selected card into a different card, the original card still cannot be deselected, while the other card is fine afterwards. When using Cryptid on the force-selected card, the copies are put in a "quantum" state where the copies are not force-selected by default, but they cannot be deselected once selected. Using The Hanged Man afterwards on the currently force-selected card will automatically force the leftmost copy to be selected. Discarding cards or playing a hand resets the quantum state of these copies, and they can be freely selected and deselected again afterwards.

title: Cerulean Bell
text: Cerulean Bell: The player can still discard the forcefully selected playing card, though it would result into another playing card to be forcefully selected instead. Trivia: Bells are a suit in German decks, replacing Diamonds. Cerulean Bell appears alongside Crimson Heart on an Ante Up! shirt due to an official merchandise collaboration with Fangamer. Cerulean Bell and Crimson Heart are so far the first and only boss/showdown blinds to appear on or as a part of any physical merchandise.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: Crimson Heart (Blind). Type: Showdown. Description: One random Joker disabled every hand. Minimum Ante: 8. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 8. Matador: ✗ No. Crimson Heart is a Showdown Blind that debuffs a random Joker in possession every hand. It never picks the same Joker twice in a row, unless it is the player's only Joker.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: For example, if a player has 5 Jokers, and Joker #3 gets debuffed by Crimson Heart, that Joker will be disabled until the player plays a hand. Once the hand is played, Joker #3 will no longer be debuffed, but instead, a different random Joker will be debuffed, such as Joker #5. Usage notes: Jokers already debuffed (due to Perishable sticker) will never be chosen when Crimson Heart randomly selects a Joker. Selling Luchador when debuffed does not disable Crimson Heart. If Mr. Bones is debuffed on the final hand, it cannot activate to save the player.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: If Mr. Bones is debuffed on the final hand, it cannot activate to save the player. On the winning hand, Crimson Heart debuffs a Joker until the next shop. This means some Jokers might not behave as expected at the end of the round: End-of-round economy Jokers such as Golden Joker or Cloud 9 will not grant money. Egg and Gift Card will not upgrade. Rocket will not upgrade and will not grant money. Invisible Joker will delay its countdown by 1 round. Campfire and Hit the Road will not reset, allowing the player to scale them for another ante or round respectively. Gros Michel and Cavendish cannot go extinct, guaranteeing a Stake Sticker on them.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: Gros Michel and Cavendish cannot go extinct, guaranteeing a Stake Sticker on them. Popcorn and Turtle Bean will not degrade. This is a rare case where a Perishable version of them will be out of sync with their natural countdown. A debuffed Perishable Joker will still degrade as normal. Similarly, a debuffed Rental Joker will still charge the player $3 at the end of the round. The Jokerless challenge bans Crimson Heart. Strategies: You can disable Crimson Heart's effect with Chicot or by selling Luchador. Note that selling Luchador while it is debuffed will not disable Crimson Heart's effect.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: You can play a useless hand to get Crimson Heart to debuff a different Joker. This can be useful if you are preparing to play a big hand and need the effect of certain Jokers. Having lots of Jokers from increased Joker slots or Negative Jokers lowers the chance of Crimson Heart disabling important Jokers. When certain Jokers are debuffed, you can make certain actions that you wouldn't otherwise. For example, if Obelisk is debuffed, you can play your most-played hand without resetting it; if Ramen is debuffed, you can discard without losing xMult, etc.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: A debuffed Loyalty Card will still count every hand played toward its 6 hands requirement. If the Joker is active when it's debuffed, it will not trigger until it is enabled again.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: DNA and Sixth Sense can only work on the first hand ever of a round. So if the player is unlucky and gets one of them debuffed by Crimson Heart on the first hand, then the player is denied its value for that round. Similarly, Burnt Joker and Trading Card can only work on the first discard ever of a round. Although for their case if they are debuffed on the first hand, the player can play a throwaway hand before using their first discard to move the debuff effect to another Joker.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: With Mr. Bones, a possible strategy is to sell all Jokers except for the one being debuffed and Mr. Bones when there are two hands left. As Crimson Heart will not select a Joker consecutively, this ensures that Mr. Bones will not be debuffed during the last hand.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: If Crimson Heart debuffs any hand size increasing Joker, such as Turtle Bean or Juggler, the hand size will return to normal but current hand will stay intact until the next discard (ex: 13/8). By quitting to Main Menu and returning, the hand size actually permanently increases (ex: 13/13), giving players a permanent hand size upgrade. The same can be done with a hand size decreasing Joker such as Merry Andy or Stuntman but with different timing, quitting to Main Menu not during the hand these Jokers are Debuffed but the hand afterwards. The two strategies also work together, increasing hand size even further.

title: Crimson Heart
text: Crimson Heart: Trivia: Crimson Heart appears alongside Cerulean Bell on an Ante Up! shirt due to an official merchandise collaboration with Fangamer. Cerulean Bell and Crimson Heart are so far the first and only boss/showdown blinds to appear on or as a part of any physical merchandise. In other media: Crimson Heart makes an appearance as a boss enemy in Vampire Survivors.

title: Small Blind
text: Small Blind: Small Blind (Blind). Type: Standard. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 1x base. Reward: 3. Matador: ✗ No. The Small Blind is the first blind of each Ante. It can be skipped to receive a Tag.

title: Small Blind
text: Small Blind: On Red Stake and above and in 2 Challenge Decks (which are The Omelette and Cruelty), it provides no reward money, rather than the $3 from White Stake. In other media: The Small Blind makes an appearance as a boss enemy in Vampire Survivors.

title: The Arm
text: The Arm: The Arm (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Decrease level of played poker hand. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Arm is a boss blind that permanently decreases the level of a played poker hand by one. For example, if the player plays a Flush and it is at level 2 (50 Chips x 6 Mult), the level of this poker hand will decrease to level 1 (35 Chips x 4 Mult).

title: The Arm
text: The Arm: This boss ability is triggered before the player scores. However, it does not trigger if the played hand is at level 1 in the first place, as poker hand levels cannot go lower than level 1. Unlike many boss blind effects (e.g. suit debuffs), the effects of The Arm are not temporary - any levels lost during the round remain lost for future rounds. Strategies: You can intentionally play Poker Hands that are not the hand you are focusing on, in order to avoid decreasing the level of your hand of choice. For example, if you are focusing on playing High Cards, you may choose to play Pairs instead for this blind.

title: The Arm
text: The Arm: Space Joker, Burnt Joker, and Blue Seal can counter the effects of The Arm. Trivia: The Icon for The Arm is the Phoenician letter Yodh (𐤉), which represents an arm or hand in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Club
text: The Club: The Club (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: All Club cards are debuffed. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Club is a boss blind that debuffs all of the cards with a Club suit.

title: The Club
text: The Club: Strategies: This boss hard counters Gluttonous Joker and Onyx Agate by debuffing Club cards. Seeing Double is also useless, since Club cards are debuffed. However, debuffed Club cards will not prevent Blackboard or Flower Pot from triggering. Smeared Joker can be harmful to your build by counting Spades cards as Club cards, which result in them being debuffed. Having consumables like The Star to change your cards into a different suit for this blind can help you score cards. However, using The Lovers will result in a debuffed card since a Wild card counts as a Club.

title: The Club
text: The Club: Trivia: The Icon for The Club is the Phoenician letter Gimel (𐤂), which represents a throwing stick or camel in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. Club can also refer to a type of throwing stick, especially in historical or anthropological contexts. So this naming is some kind of pun. This is the only blind whose name and affected playing card suit match.

title: The Eye
text: The Eye: The Eye (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: No repeat hand types this round. Minimum Ante: 3. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Eye is a boss blind that restricts the player from playing a specific poker hand more than once. For example, if the player has triggered a Two Pair in this round, they will not be able to trigger another Two Pair for this round. They will have to resort to using another poker hand, instead. Attempting to trigger a repeated hand type will result in no score being added—the game says "Not allowed!" and forces Chips and Mult to 0, wasting the hand.

title: The Eye
text: The Eye: Strategies: Card Sharp is completely nullified by this Boss, since the player will not be able to play the same hand a second time. Supernova can have mixed results with this Blind depending on the run so far, as each hand can only be used once. Builds that play many different hands will have an easier time against this Boss than a build that relies on playing a single hand. Obelisk can benefit from this boss, since it encourages the player to use different hand types.

title: The Eye
text: The Eye: Obelisk can benefit from this boss, since it encourages the player to use different hand types. If a run is dependent on only a single hand type, using score-increasing tarot cards such as Justice or The Chariot may get the score needed in a single played hand. By saving these in the consumable area for this boss, it may save the run. It is important to note that Ice Cream and Seltzer still lose value even if the played hand is a hand that has already been played. Trivia: The icon for The Eye is the Phoenician letter Ayin (𐤏), which represents an eye or mouth in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Eye
text: The Eye: LocalThunk has said that The Eye bans repeat hand types because it has observed what hands you've played.

title: The Fish
text: The Fish: The Fish (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Cards drawn face down after each hand played. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Fish is a boss blind that draws cards that are face down once a hand is played. For example, if a player plays 3 cards, the 3 cards that will be drawn in their place will have their face down.

title: The Fish
text: The Fish: Strategies: The Sort feature at the bottom of the screen can narrow down what the face-down cards are. Sorting by rank sorts in descending order, with Aces being the highest rank and 2s being the lowest. Sorting by suit sorts in the order of Spades, Hearts, Clubs, then Diamonds, with each suit being sorted by rank. You can briefly see face-down cards when using certain tarot or spectral cards, e.g., The Empress or Ouija. You can use your Discards to discard cards that are face down. The cards that will be drawn in their place will be face up, unlike cards drawn in the place of played cards.

title: The Fish
text: The Fish: Trivia: The Icon for The Fish is the Phoenician letter Dalet (𐤃), which represents a door or a fish in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Flint
text: The Flint: The Flint (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Base Chips and Mult are halved. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Flint is a boss blind that halves the Base Chips and Mult for the poker hands that were played in this round. For example, if the player plays a hand with a Straight (which would score 30 Chips x 4 Mult at level 1), those numbers would be halved, therefore resulting it in being 15 Chips x 2 Mult before scoring.

title: The Flint
text: The Flint: Usage Notes: The results of Chips and Mult will be rounded up, for example, a High Card with 5 Chips x 1 Mult will score 3 Chips x 1 Mult after halving. Without scoring jokers, the Flint will removed about 75% of score from a hand. Strategies: Strategies focused solely on Multiplicative Mult and leveling Hands are worse off, effectively having their final Mult halved. To counter this, use a Joker that stacks a lot of Additive Mult, such as Supernova or Bootstraps.

title: The Flint
text: The Flint: To counter this, use a Joker that stacks a lot of Additive Mult, such as Supernova or Bootstraps. Trivia: Though the symbols and names of most of the Boss Blinds are based on the letters of the Phoenician alphabet, The Flint is an original creation by the developer, though it resembles the runic letter jera (ᛃ). According to LocalThunk, the reason for inventing a new symbol for The Flint was to bring the total number of blinds from 29 to 30 for a neat Collection screen. If the base score of the hand played exceeds Flint's requirement before halving but not after, the flame effect will appear first and then disappear, which may be a bug.

title: The Goad
text: The Goad: The Goad (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: All Spade cards are debuffed. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Goad is a Boss Blind that debuffs all of the cards with a Spade suit.

title: The Goad
text: The Goad: Strategies: This boss hard counters Wrathful Joker and Arrowhead by debuffing Spade cards. However, debuffed Spade cards will not prevent Blackboard or Flower Pot from triggering. Smeared Joker can be harmful to your build by counting Club cards as Spade cards, which result in them being debuffed. Having consumables like The Moon to change your cards into a different suit for this blind can help you score cards. However, using The Lovers will result in a debuffed card since a Wild card counts as a Spade. Checkered Deck has half of its cards debuffed since it starts with 26 Spade cards.

title: The Goad
text: The Goad: Checkered Deck has half of its cards debuffed since it starts with 26 Spade cards. Trivia: The icon for the Goad is the Phoenician letter Lamedh (𐤋), which represents a shepherd’s crook or goad in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Head
text: The Head: The Head (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: All Heart cards are debuffed. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Head is a boss blind that debuffs all of the cards with a Heart suit.

title: The Head
text: The Head: Strategies: This boss hard counters Lusty Joker and Bloodstone by debuffing Heart cards. However, debuffed Heart cards will not prevent Flower Pot from triggering. Smeared Joker can be harmful to your build by counting Diamonds cards as Heart cards, which result in them being debuffed. Having consumables like The World to change your cards into a different suit for this blind to score cards. However, using The Lovers will result in a debuffed card since a Wild card counts as a Heart suit. Checkered Deck has half of its cards debuffed since it starts with 26 Heart cards.

title: The Head
text: The Head: Checkered Deck has half of its cards debuffed since it starts with 26 Heart cards. Trivia: The icon for The Head is the Phoenician letter Resh (𐤓), which represents a human head in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Hook
text: The Hook: The Hook (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Discards 2 random cards per hand played. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Hook is a boss blind that discards two cards held in the player's hand after each played hand.

title: The Hook
text: The Hook: Strategies: Playing certain hands such as Straight or Full House which can't be guaranteed with discards alone may be significantly affected by The Hook, as the player can't play hands to draw more cards that would fit the hand they already have. All effects from cards held in hand can't be guaranteed, such as Blue Seal, Steel cards and Gold cards, and scoring from Jokers such as Baron or Shoot the Moon. However, unless there are no cards remaining in the hand, cards discarded by The Hook may result in a better Raised Fist score.

title: The Hook
text: The Hook: The Hook may help by triggering effects via discarding, such as discarding cards with Purple Seals or activating discard-focused Jokers like Mail-In Rebate, Hit the Road, and Castle. If only one card is held in the player's hand, it can also trigger Trading Card, and it can do so more than once until a normal discard is used. This effect can also decrease Ramen and Green Joker's Multiplier. However, the Hook's discards will not prevent Delayed Gratification from taking effect, trigger Burnt Joker, or cost $1 during Golden Needle. Trivia: The icon for The Hook is the Phoenician letter Waw (𐤅), which represents a hook in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Hook
text: The Hook: This is the Boss Blind on the "TUTORIAL" seed's Ante 1, first given as a tutorial to new players.

title: The House
text: The House: The House (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: First hand is drawn face down. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The House is a boss blind that draws the first hand of playing cards face down.

title: The House
text: The House: Strategies: It is better to have a small hand size during The House, as this essentially means that the player will have less cards drawn face down, so consider using anything that decreases hand size, such as Stuntman. Conversely, you should avoid anything that increases hand size, such as Troubadour. Builds that do not rely on playing specific poker hands, but instead rely on Jokers, are particularly effective against The House.

title: The House
text: The House: The Sort feature at the bottom of the screen can narrow down what the face-down cards are. Sorting by rank sorts in descending order, with Aces being the highest rank and 2s being the lowest. Sorting by suit sorts in the order of Spades, Hearts, Clubs, then Diamonds, with each suit being sorted by rank. You can briefly see face-down cards when using certain tarot or spectral cards, e.g., The Empress or Ouija.

title: The House
text: The House: You can briefly see face-down cards when using certain tarot or spectral cards, e.g., The Empress or Ouija. It is possible to see what cards are face down by playing the face down cards instead of discarding them. This is particularly helpful for seeing which kind of hand would be most likely to form, but you might be able to reach the score requirement if you need all hands to effectively score in order to beat the blind. Trivia: The Icon for The House is the Phoenician letter Bet (𐤁), which represents a house in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Manacle
text: The Manacle: The Manacle (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: -1 Hand Size. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Manacle is a boss blind that reduces the hand size by 1. For example, if the player's usual hand size is 8, it would be 7 only for this round.

title: The Manacle
text: The Manacle: Strategies: The Manacle can be less punishing on Painted Deck, as the boss would only reduce the player's hand size to 9 instead of 7, which is still plenty of space to find desired cards (assuming no alterations to hand size were previously made). Purchasing the Paint Brush and Palette Vouchers can help offset The Manacle's penalty. Juggler, Troubadour and Turtle Bean all give hand size, helping offset The Manacle's penalty. The Juggle Tag can also be used to counter The Manacle (assuming the tag appears right before the boss blind or the player uses skips). Avoid Jokers that reduce hand size such as Stuntman and Merry Andy as the effect will stack with The Manacle.

title: The Manacle
text: The Manacle: Avoid Jokers that reduce hand size such as Stuntman and Merry Andy as the effect will stack with The Manacle. Jokers with held in hand abilities vary with The Manacle's effectiveness. Baron, Shoot the Moon, and Reserved Parking are all weakened due to holding fewer face cards in hand. Inversely, Raised Fist actually benefits, as the player is less likely to hold a card with a low rank at any moment. Be mindful of Ectoplasm's and Ouija's hand size penalty when using them if The Manacle is the current Boss Blind of the Ante. In particular, repeated Ectoplasm usage may make it impossible to form certain poker hands feasibly, which is only compounded by the Boss Blind's innate ability.

title: The Manacle
text: The Manacle: The Manacle is able to decrease hand size to 0, resulting in an instant game over, so avoid selecting it with a hand size of 1 if possible. It is possible to use the temporary reduction of hand size from the Manacle to unlock Palette. Luchador and Chicot disable the boss blind when their effect is activated, restoring the player's original hand size. Due to how Chicot "disables" boss blinds, having multiple copies of Chicot can allow the player to permanently increase their hand size, with each copy increasing it by 1. This is a more niche strategy of obtaining the elusive naneinf score. However, it is incredibly difficult and expensive to pull off without a lot of set-up.

title: The Manacle
text: The Manacle: Trivia: The icon for The Manacle is the Phoenician letter Zayin (𐤆), which represents a weapon or manacle in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. A "manacle" is a device used to restrain or confine one's hands (eg. a handcuff or a shackle). This ties into the boss's effect of lowering the player's hand size by 1, which can make it harder to draw certain cards from their deck. In other media: The Manacle makes an appearance as a boss enemy in Vampire Survivors.

title: The Mark
text: The Mark: The Mark (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: All face cards are drawn face down. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Mark is a boss blind that draws all of the face cards face down. In other words, all of the cards with either a "King", "Queen", or "Jack" card rank, are drawn face down.

title: The Mark
text: The Mark: Notes: During the Mark, using Strength to turn face cards into non-face ones, or using Death to copy a face-down card to an upturned one will only briefly uncover it; conversely, turning a non-face card into a face card during won't make it face-down. Anti-Synergies: Mad World is particularly sensitive to this Boss Blind, as it starts with an Eternal Pareidolia, meaning all cards are drawn face down. Pareidolia: All cards are drawn face down, making it much more difficult to assemble a sufficiently scoring hand.

title: The Mark
text: The Mark: Pareidolia: All cards are drawn face down, making it much more difficult to assemble a sufficiently scoring hand. Strategies: The Sort feature at the bottom of the screen can narrow down what the face-down cards are. Sorting by rank sorts in descending order with: King, Queen, Jack. Sorting by suit sorts in the order of Spades, Hearts, Clubs, then Diamonds, with each suit being sorted by rank. You can briefly see face-down cards when using certain tarot or spectral cards, e.g., The Empress or Ouija. Consider selling Pareidolia before entering the boss blind if your scoring relies on specific poker hands.

title: The Mark
text: The Mark: Consider selling Pareidolia before entering the boss blind if your scoring relies on specific poker hands. Trivia: The icon for The Mark is the Phoenician letter Taw (𐤕), which represents a mark (or crossed sticks) in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Mouth
text: The Mouth: The Mouth (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Play only 1 hand type this round. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Mouth is a boss blind that restricts the player to only playing hands with the hand type that they have used on the first hand of this round. For example, if the player has triggered a Full House on their first hand, they will only be able to score hands with a Full House. Attempting to score other hand types will result in no score being added -- the game says "Not allowed!" and forces Chips and Mult to 0, wasting the hand.

title: The Mouth
text: The Mouth: Strategies: If the player's strategy revolves mainly around a hand that is difficult to draw (such as Four of a Kind), it is recommended to use Jokers that help with looking for cards like Drunkard to prevent getting locked into an undesirable hand due to not being able to play the correct hand as the first hand. If possible, hold on to a Death, Strength, or suit changer like The Sun in the consumable area to form the desired hand as a backup plan. Be sure to remember not to play High Card (unless you can clear the blind this way) to activate DNA or Sixth Sense.

title: The Mouth
text: The Mouth: If you played a High Card and have the Splash, that joker can be used for attempts at maximizing the score. Consider selling Burglar as you will be forced to play a hand type that is drawn in your first hand. It is important to note that Ice Cream and Seltzer still lose value even if the played hand isn't the hand that you played on your first hand. Trivia: The icon for The Mouth is the Phoenician letter Pe (𐤐), which represents a mouth or head in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Needle
text: The Needle: The Needle (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Play only 1 hand. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 1x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Needle is a boss blind that sets the player's hands to 1 at the start of the blind.

title: The Needle
text: The Needle: Notes: Getting Troubadour during The Needle cannot reduce hands per round below 1. Strategies: Burglar is a great counter to The Needle, as it bypasses the 1-hand restriction and still gives 3 extra hands. This is improved further by copying Burglar with Blueprint or Brainstorm. Using Luchador or Chicot against The Needle gives the player their hands back, but keeps the lowered blind requirement. Avoid using Card Sharp, as it becomes completely nullified by this boss (unless the player has Burglar). Avoid using DNA or Sixth Sense, unless the player can score high enough with High Card.

title: The Needle
text: The Needle: Avoid using DNA or Sixth Sense, unless the player can score high enough with High Card. Using the Justice Tarot card to get the X2 Mult may be worth the risk of the card shattering in order to meet the threshold. If possible, it can be saved in the consumable area to ensure it can be used on the single hand given. Because the player can no longer use hands as discards, they may struggle to find their ideal poker hand. Some mitigation methods include: A bigger hand size from the Painted Deck, Jokers like Juggler and Troubadour, or the Paint Brush and Palette vouchers.

title: The Needle
text: The Needle: A bigger hand size from the Painted Deck, Jokers like Juggler and Troubadour, or the Paint Brush and Palette vouchers. More discards from the Red Deck, Jokers like Drunkard and Merry Andy, or the Wasteful and Recyclomancy vouchers. More score form Acrobat and Dusk. Trivia: The icon for The Needle is the Phoenician letter Qoph (𐤒), which represents a needle eye in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. The Needle requires precision in reference to the phrase "thread the needle".

title: The Ox
text: The Ox: The Ox (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Playing a (most played hand) sets money to $0. Minimum Ante: 6. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Ox is a Boss Blind that sets the player's money to $0 if they play their most played hand during a run. In case of a tie between multiple hands, The Ox will pick one at random.[verify]

title: The Ox
text: The Ox: Usage Notes: The most played hand is determined once the player has defeated the previous boss and enters the current ante. Changing the most played hand during the Small/Big Blind will not change the chosen hand, and rerolling into The Ox using e.g. Director's Cut will pick the most played hand from the start of the ante. The Ox only applies to the scoring hand, not the hands that it contains. For example, playing a Straight Flush with the most played hand being Flush or Straight does not clear the player's money. Royal Flush is not considered a separate hand by the Ox.

title: The Ox
text: The Ox: Royal Flush is not considered a separate hand by the Ox. If the player has $0 when The Ox sets money to 0, the game will display this change as +$0. Strategies: If the player plays their most played hand and has the Matador, the boss ability will be triggered, then the Matador will provide $8. The boss ability can provide an advantage for players who have less than $0, since their money is technically increased. With the Credit Card, where players can go up to -$20 in debt, players can earn up to an extra $20 with the boss ability. Obelisk already encourages players to not play their most played hand, making this Boss Blind irrelevant in most cases.

title: The Ox
text: The Ox: Obelisk already encourages players to not play their most played hand, making this Boss Blind irrelevant in most cases. Vagabond is guaranteed to trigger if the player plays their most played hand. Trivia: The Icon for The Ox is the Phoenician letter Aleph (𐤀), which represents an ox head in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. In other media: The Ox makes an appearance as a boss enemy in Vampire Survivors.

title: The Pillar
text: The Pillar: The Pillar (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Cards played previously this Ante are debuffed. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Pillar is a Boss Blind that debuffs all of the playing cards that were previously played in the current Ante. In other words, cards played in the current Ante's Small Blind and/or the Big Blind (if played at all) will be debuffed.

title: The Pillar
text: The Pillar: Notes: Changing Ante with Hieroglyph or Petroglyph does not affect the Pillar, and the played cards will still be debuffed. Strategies: Skipping both the Small Blind and the Big Blind would result in no debuffed cards. If a debuffed card has its enhancement changed by a Tarot card, the card will now be "different" and thus no longer be debuffed. This only occurs for enhancements; suit and rank changes, as well as the Aura Spectral card and cards that add seals like Trance, will not count.

title: The Pillar
text: The Pillar: If the player converts a non-debuffed card into a debuffed card using Death, the non-debuffed card will become debuffed too, even though the player technically has not played that card that Ante. The opposite is also true; if the player converts a debuffed card into a non-debuffed card, it will remove the debuff. Similarly, using Cryptid on a debuffed card will spawn two additional debuffed cards. Trivia: The icon for The Pillar is the Phoenician letter Samekh (𐤎), which represents a pillar in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. The Pillar's effect is based on a famous section of the bible story of Lot, where his wife is turned to a pillar of salt after she looked back.

title: The Plant
text: The Plant: The Plant (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: All face cards are debuffed. Minimum Ante: 4. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Plant is a Boss Blind that debuffs all of the face cards. This includes cards with a "King", "Queen", or "Jack" rank, and cards affected by Pareidolia.

title: The Plant
text: The Plant: Usage notes: The Mad World challenge bans The Plant. Strategies: Pareidolia makes The Plant debuff every card as every card is considered to be a face card. Jokers that interact with face cards, such as Photograph, Smiley Face, and Baron are completely unusable. For builds that rely on face cards, the only method to "defeat" The Plant is to avoid it entirely. Luchador and Chicot disable Boss Blinds, making face cards usable again. Director's Cut and Retcon allow the player to pay $10 to reroll the current Boss Blind. Boss Tag rerolls the Boss Blind for no cost.

title: The Plant
text: The Plant: Boss Tag rerolls the Boss Blind for no cost. On the contrary, Ride the Bus actually benefits from The Plant. Its Mult bonus will not be reset, even if a (debuffed) face card is played. Trivia: The icon for The Plant is the Phoenician letter Tsade (𐤑), which represents a papyrus plant or fish Hook in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. The Plant debuffs face cards because plants do not have faces. This is the only non-showdown boss blind to be banned in a challenge.

title: The Psychic
text: The Psychic: The Psychic (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Must play 5 cards. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Psychic is a Boss Blind that requires the player to play 5 cards in a hand. The hand doesn't require for all of the cards to trigger, but it is required to play 5 cards, otherwise, the player will not be able to score anything at all.

title: The Psychic
text: The Psychic: Strategies: Using Splash can help with adding extra score when 5-card poker hands are unable to be assembled. Don't reduce hand size too much, for example with Stuntman or Merry Andy. If your hand size is 4 or below, you will be unable to play any 5-card hand. This also applies with Ouija and Ectoplasm. DNA, Sixth Sense, and Half Joker are completely unusable when encountering this boss blind, as they requires hands with less than 5 cards, while The Psychic requires for a hand to always contain 5 cards. Square Joker also cannot scale during this Blind.

title: The Psychic
text: The Psychic: Square Joker also cannot scale during this Blind. It is important to note that Ice Cream and Seltzer still lose value even if the played hand has 4 or less cards. Trivia: The Icon for The Psychic is the Phoenician letter Kaph (𐤊), which represents palm of a hand in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. According to LocalThunk, this name comes from palm reading.

title: The Serpent
text: The Serpent: The Serpent (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: After Play or Discard, always draw 3 cards. Minimum Ante: 5. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Serpent is a Boss Blind that would always draw 3 cards after a player either plays or discards any number of cards.

title: The Serpent
text: The Serpent: Strategies: Discarding a single card or two will allow for 3 cards to come in their place, which would help temporarily increase the hand size. This helps with finding more difficult hands while also synergizing with Jokers like Baron and Steel cards that benefit from the larger hand size. Trivia: The icon for The Serpent is the Phoenician letter Nun (𐤍), which represents a serpent or fish in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Tooth
text: The Tooth: The Tooth (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Lose $1 per card played. Minimum Ante: 3. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Tooth is a Boss Blind that makes the player lose $1 for each card they play. For example, if the player plays a Straight in one hand, which would consist of 5 cards, the player will lose $5. Unscored cards also cause the player to lose money; for example, a Pair with three unscored cards would also lose $5. Even if a player has $0 in possession, the boss ability will continue to trigger and push the player into debt.

title: The Tooth
text: The Tooth: Strategies: Picking up Credit Card before the round or keeping a Wraith in hand can help the player recover from going into debt. Gold cards and Gold Seals can help offset the penalty. Golden Ticket allows the player to play Gold cards for a net increase of $1, or more if the player has Retrigger Jokers. Any Economy Joker can help offset The Tooth's penalty, although the player may still lose out on Interest. Mail-In Rebate, Golden Joker, and To Do List are Common Jokers, making them relatively easy to obtain. Vagabond has the potential to benefit as the Money penalty may make the played Poker Hand fulfill its condition, generating Tarot cards.

title: The Tooth
text: The Tooth: Ideally, poker hands with few cards such as High Card or Pair should be used to defeat The Tooth so as to minimize the Money penalty. Trivia: The icon for The Tooth is the Phoenician letter Shin (𐤔), which represents teeth in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Wall
text: The Wall: The Wall (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Extra large blind. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 4x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Wall is a Boss Blind where the player has to score 4 times the base score of a particular Ante. For example, in Ante 2, the base score (or the score of the Small Blind) on white Stake is 800, so that would mean the required score to beat The Wall would be 3,200.

title: The Wall
text: The Wall: Jokers: Chicot and Luchador can disable the effects of The Wall, removing the extra score requirement and returning the scaling to 2x the base score. Holding on to multiple copies of Chicot will continue to reduce the blind size below its original value. Loyalty Card can be a good source of a one-time high score against this boss, provided the player can set it up correctly earlier in the Ante. Campfire can be an even more powerful scoring joker for this Ante only, if the player has the money to buy and sell enough cards. Turtle Bean can be used to find powerful hands many times in one round for a limited number of rounds.

title: The Wall
text: The Wall: Turtle Bean can be used to find powerful hands many times in one round for a limited number of rounds. Mr. Bones effectively provides X4 Mult for 1 round, at the cost of the blind reward money. Consumables: Suit changers, specifically The World, The Sun, The Moon, and The Star can be held in a consumable slot and used in the early game to turn a Full House into a Flush House, and score 1 big hand without any scoring Jokers. Enhancements: Glass cards can be used to score a lot, at the cost of a chance to break valuable cards.

title: The Wall
text: The Wall: Enhancements: Glass cards can be used to score a lot, at the cost of a chance to break valuable cards. Trivia: The Icon for The Wall is the Phoenician letter Heth (𐤇), which represents a courtyard or wall in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. The boss ability and color of this blind is similar to that of the showdown boss blind Violet Vessel, where the required score to complete the round is really large. In other media: The Wall makes an appearance as a boss enemy in Vampire Survivors.

title: The Water
text: The Water: The Water (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: Start with 0 discards. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Water is a boss blind that sets the number of the player's discards to 0 for the round.

title: The Water
text: The Water: Strategies: Picking up Burglar prior to the blind can give additional hands without any downside. The player can use the extra hands as "discards" to find less common poker hands like Straight, Four of a Kind, etc. Mystic Summit will immediately get +15 Mult, since the blind starts with 0 discards. Jokers that increase Hand size, such as Juggler or Troubadour, can be advantageous for assembling uncommon poker hands. The Paint Brush and Palette Vouchers can also be useful for this purpose. The Juggle Tag can also be used to counter The Water (assuming the tag appears right before the boss blind or the player uses skips).

title: The Water
text: The Water: This blind hard-counters builds focused around discards, such as those focused on Hit the Road and Banner. It also reduces the amount of money potentially gained from Jokers like Delayed Gratification and Mail-In Rebate. It prevents the player from further building Yorick, Burnt Joker, and Castle stacks. Golden Needle is particularly sensitive to this boss blind, given that there can only be one hand each round with no opportunity to fish for new cards. Drunkard and Merry Andy are ineffective against this blind, as their extra discards will not be given. Green Joker and Ramen cannot lose Mult. Luchador and Chicot disable the Water's effect, restoring the player's discards.

title: The Water
text: The Water: Green Joker and Ramen cannot lose Mult. Luchador and Chicot disable the Water's effect, restoring the player's discards. Due to how Chicot "disables" boss blinds, players with multiple copies of the Joker can enter the blind and give themselves more discards than what is normally possible. For example, if the player has 3 discards and has 4 copies of Chicot, they will be given 12 discards upon entering the blind. However, it should be noted that when the Water is defeated and the player moves on to the next ante, their discards will return to their normal amount, making this strategy more of a gimmick than an actual plan.

title: The Water
text: The Water: Trivia: The Icon for The Water is the Phoenician letter Mem (𐤌), which represents water in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: The Wheel
text: The Wheel: The Wheel (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: 1 in 7 cards get drawn face down. Minimum Ante: 2. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: ✗ No. The Wheel is a Boss Blind that has a 1 in 7 chance to draw a card face down anytime a card is drawn from the deck.

title: The Wheel
text: The Wheel: Strategies: The Sort feature at the bottom of the screen can narrow down what the face down cards are. Sorting by rank sorts in descending order, with Aces being the highest rank and 2s being the lowest. Sorting by suit sorts in the order of Spades, Hearts, Clubs, then Diamonds, with each suit being sorted by rank. The player can briefly see face-down cards when using certain Tarot or Spectral cards, e.g., The Empress or Ouija. Oops! All 6s is an anti-synergy as it increases the probability that a card is drawn face down.

title: The Wheel
text: The Wheel: Oops! All 6s is an anti-synergy as it increases the probability that a card is drawn face down. Due to the inherent random nature of The Wheel, there may be occasions where its effect is quite detrimental, or its effect may not matter at all. Regardless, to prepare for The Wheel, the player may want to lean towards a Joker setup that doesn't rely on any specific Poker Hand and can score reliably regardless of what is played. An example of this would be any Chips Joker, an Additive Mult Joker, and a Multiplicative Mult Joker, such as: Blue Joker, Red Card, and Constellation.

title: The Wheel
text: The Wheel: Trivia: The Icon for The Wheel is the Phoenician letter Teth (𐤈), which represents a Wheel in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived. The Wheel's name was chosen because it has a chance-based effect, similar to The Wheel of Fortune. As the description of Boss Blind is plain text without style, The Wheel has the only Listed probability that is not displayed in green text.

title: The Window
text: The Window: The Window (Blind). Type: Boss. Description: All Diamond cards are debuffed. Minimum Ante: Any. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 5. Matador: Yes. The Window is a boss blind that debuffs all of the cards with a Diamond suit.

title: The Window
text: The Window: Strategies: This boss hard counters Greedy Joker and Rough Gem by debuffing all Diamond cards. However, debuffed Diamond cards will not prevent Flower Pot from triggering. Smeared Joker can be harmful to your build by counting Hearts cards as Diamond cards that will be debuffed as a result. Having consumables like The Moon to change the suit of your cards during this blind can help score cards. However, The Lovers will result in a debuffed card since a Wild card counts as a Diamond. Trivia: The Icon for The Window is the Phoenician letter He (𐤄), which represents a window in the hieroglyphics from which it is derived.

title: Verdant Leaf
text: Verdant Leaf: Verdant Leaf (Blind). Type: Showdown. Description: All cards debuffed until 1 Joker sold. Minimum Ante: 8. Score Requirement: 2x base. Reward: 8. Matador: Yes. Verdant Leaf is a showdown blind that debuffs all of the playing cards in the deck until 1 Joker is sold.

title: Verdant Leaf
text: Verdant Leaf: Usage notes: The Non-Perishable, Typecast, and Jokerless challenges ban Verdant Leaf. The former two's gimmick revolve around Jokers being Eternal, while the latter forbids any way of obtaining Jokers to begin with. Strategies: It is advised to sell a Joker that does not contribute to score, such as an economy Joker or a useless Negative Joker. If the player does not have a plan for endless mode, some effect Jokers can be sold after they take effect, such as Burglar or Marble Joker after selecting the blind, and Burnt Joker (which does work on debuffed cards) after first discard.

title: Verdant Leaf
text: Verdant Leaf: Selling an Invisible Joker creates a copy of certain held Joker, which satisfies the blind's condition while potentially giving a useful Joker. Entering the blind with a Judgement or Wraith in consumable slot allows the player to create a random Joker after selling one. It is not necessary to sell a Joker to beat this blind; having a high leveled poker hand and/or strong Jokers can be sufficient despite having all cards debuffed. Surprisingly, the card spawned from Marble Joker in the round does not get debuffed. If the player manages to draw that card, the +50 Chips might help. However, this interaction does not occur with Certificate.

title: Verdant Leaf
text: Verdant Leaf: Trivia: After selling a Joker, the description of Verdant Leaf will disappear, like other Boss Blinds do after being disabled. If Luchador is sold during Verdant Leaf, it will disable the Blind before Verdant Leaf can disable itself. This can be inferred from the ordering of getting the sell value and the Blind being disabled, and is confirmed by the source code. Leaves are a suit in German decks, replacing Spades.

title: Violet Vessel
text: Violet Vessel: Violet Vessel (Blind). Type: Showdown. Description: Very large blind. Minimum Ante: 8. Score Requirement: 6x base. Reward: 8. Matador: ✗ No. Violet Vessel is a Showdown Blind where the player has to score 6 times the base score of a particular Ante (that is a multiple of 8). For example, in Ante 8, the base score (or the score of the Small Blind) on white Stake is 50,000, so that would mean the required score to beat the Violet Vessel would be 300,000.

title: Violet Vessel
text: Violet Vessel: Jokers: Chicot and Luchador can disable the effects of Violet Vessel, removing the extra score requirement and returning the scaling to 2x the base score. Holding on to multiple copies of Chicot will continue to reduce the blind size below its original value. Loyalty Card can be a good source of a one-time high score against this boss, provided the player can set it up correctly earlier in the Ante. Campfire can be an even more powerful scoring joker for this Ante only, if the player has the money to buy and sell enough cards. Turtle Bean can be used to find powerful hands many times in one round for a limited number of rounds.

title: Violet Vessel
text: Violet Vessel: Turtle Bean can be used to find powerful hands many times in one round for a limited number of rounds. Mr. Bones effectively provides X4 Mult for 1 round, at the cost of the blind reward money. Enhancements: Glass cards can be used to score a lot, at the cost of a chance to break valuable cards. Trivia: Cups are a suit in Italian and Spanish decks, replacing Hearts. The boss ability and color of this blind is quite similar to that of the regular boss blind The Wall, where the required score to complete the round is really large.

title: Boss Tag
text: Boss Tag: Boss Tag (Tag). Description: Rerolls the Boss Blind. Appearing from Ante: Any. The Boss Tag immediately re-rolls the next Boss Blind.

title: Boss Tag
text: Boss Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This Tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: If Director's Cut has been redeemed, using the Boss Tag to reroll the next Boss Blind will use up the one reroll option. However, if done in the opposite order, by rerolling using Director's Cut first, the player can still reroll once more using the Boss Tag. Strategy: Boss Tag can be useful when the play style of a round is extremely fragile to certain Boss Blinds, for example: With a deck mostly consisting of a certain suit, or with Smeared Joker: The Club, The Goad, The Window, and The Head.

title: Boss Tag
text: Boss Tag: With a deck mostly consisting of face cards, or with Pareidolia: The Plant, The Mark. With a high-leveled hand: The Flint. Relying on a certain hand type, or with Card Sharp: The Eye and The Arm. Relying on using discards to build hands: The Wheel, The Water, Cerulean Bell. Relying on combination of all held Jokers: Verdant Leaf, Crimson Heart. Relying on good economy: The Ox and The Tooth. Relying on hands that are hard to play, or with Burglar: The Mouth and The Fish. Being relatively weak and relying on multiple hands to defeat blinds: The Needle, The Wall, and Violet Vessel. With a big hand size: The House.

title: Boss Tag
text: Boss Tag: With a big hand size: The House. Overall, the player should weigh the risk of skipping carefully if encountering one of the above using one such build, as skipping in general can often impacts the scaling of a run.

title: Buffoon Tag
text: Buffoon Tag: Buffoon Tag (Tag). Description: Gives a free Mega Buffoon Pack. Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Buffoon Tag makes the player acquire and then immediately open a Mega Buffoon Pack for free. This Booster Pack allows the player to choose 2 Jokers among 4 that are presented.

title: Buffoon Tag
text: Buffoon Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination) can be activated as normal. On higher Stakes, the choices in the pack can have Stickers. This Tag is similar to the Top-up Tag, as they both give 2 Jokers and appear starting at Ante 2. However, the Jokers from the Top-up Tag cannot be picked from, cannot have in-run Stickers, and have to be Common. The Jokerless challenge bans Buffoon Tag.

title: Charm Tag
text: Charm Tag: Charm Tag (Tag). Description: Gives a free Mega Arcana Pack. Appearing from Ante: Any. The Charm Tag makes the player acquire and then immediately open a Mega Arcana Pack for free. This Booster Pack allows the player to choose 2 Tarot cards among 5 that are presented.

title: Charm Tag
text: Charm Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination) can be activated as normal. The chance of getting The Soul from this tag is approximately 1.5%. Trivia: This is one of 15 Tags, and the only pack-related Tags that can appear in Ante 1.

title: Coupon Tag
text: Coupon Tag: Coupon Tag (Tag). Description: Initial cards and booster packs in next shop are free. Appearing from Ante: Any. The Coupon Tag makes all of the Jokers, Consumables, and Booster Packs that appear upon first entering The Shop cost nothing. This tag does not apply to Vouchers, nor any Jokers or Consumables that appear after a reroll.

title: Coupon Tag
text: Coupon Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Strategies: The best time to take this tag is Ante 1, as the player will not have very much money saved at the time. This Tag can be seen as a slightly worse version of the Investment Tag. Although no money can be saved for interest from it, the free Jokers and Consumables can generate money themselves, or can help with scoring for the next ante so the player is more comfortable saving money.

title: D6 Tag
text: D6 Tag: D6 Tag (Tag). Description: Rerolls in next shop start at $0. Appearing from Ante: Any. The D6 Tag makes rerolls start at $0 (then, increase by $1 for each reroll) the next time the player visits The Shop.

title: D6 Tag
text: D6 Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: Whenever multiple D6 tags are stacked, the game will only use one tag at a time per shop. Similarly to Coupon Tag, the D6 Tag gives money indirectly by making the shop cheaper. This saves $5 per reroll without either reroll voucher, $3 with Reroll Surplus, and $1 with Reroll Glut. Without Reroll Surplus, it takes 17 rerolls in 1 shop with the D6 Tag for the cost per card seen to be equal to spreading out rerolls between that shop and the one skipped.

title: D6 Tag
text: D6 Tag: This does not take into account spreading the rerolls across multiple shops, the value lost from Booster Packs, or from playing the round itself (e.g. from Gold cards). Synergies: Flash Card stacks can be built up efficiently with this tag; however, obtaining this tag does necessitate skipping at least one shop.

title: Double Tag
text: Double Tag: Double Tag (Tag). Description: Gives a copy of the next selected Tag, Double Tag excluded. Appearing from Ante: Any. The Double Tag copies the next Tag, causing you to gain the benefit of the skip twice (or more if you have more double tags).

title: Double Tag
text: Double Tag: For example, if you skip both the Small Blind and the Big Blind on Ante has an Uncommon Tag and then a Double Tag while holding a Double Tag, the Uncommon Tag would be duplicated by the Double Tag that you already have, while keeping the second Double Tag since it was obtained after the Uncommon Tag. The Double Tag does not work on itself. It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: Another way of obtaining a Double Tag is by selling the Diet Cola.

title: Double Tag
text: Double Tag: Notes: Another way of obtaining a Double Tag is by selling the Diet Cola. Using the Anaglyph Deck will give a Double Tag every time a Boss Blind is defeated.

title: Economy Tag
text: Economy Tag: Economy Tag (Tag). Description: Doubles your money, (Max of $40). Appearing from Ante: Any. The Economy Tag doubles the player's money if it is below $40; otherwise, it adds $40.

title: Economy Tag
text: Economy Tag: For example, if the player has $35 before claiming this tag, their money would be doubled to $70 after the tag is claimed. However, if they have $55 before claiming this tag, their money would be $95 after claiming the tag. It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: If your balance is negative, your money is not doubled, instead giving you $0 and essentially wasting the tag.

title: Ethereal Tag
text: Ethereal Tag: Ethereal Tag (Tag). Description: Gives a free Spectral Pack. Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Ethereal Tag makes the player acquire and then immediately open a Spectral Pack for free. This Booster Pack would allow for the player to choose 1 Spectral card among 2 that are presented.

title: Ethereal Tag
text: Ethereal Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination) can be activated as normal. Anti-Synergies: Ghost Deck already allows Spectral cards to appear in the Shop, making the Ethereal Skip tag less valuable. Trivia: This is the only tag, among the other Booster Pack tags, that does not open up a "Mega" Booster Pack. It opens up a "normal" one instead. The word "ethereal" is synonymous for terms that connect to the supernatural, like "otherworldly," "heavenly," or "spiritual," which ties into the tag's ability to create a free Spectral Pack.

title: Foil Tag
text: Foil Tag: Foil Tag (Tag). Description: Next base edition shop Joker is free and becomes Foil. Appearing from Ante: Any. Unlock Requirement: Discover the Foil edition. The Foil Tag makes the next base edition Joker found in the Shop cost $0 and come with a Foil edition.

title: Foil Tag
text: Foil Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This Tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: If there are no base edition Jokers in the next shop, this Tag will instead be stored. Works with the Uncommon Tag and Rare Tag if the generated Joker does not have an edition naturally. On Black Stake and higher, the Joker affected by the Foil Tag can have any in-run Sticker that is available for that Stake. The Jokerless challenge bans Foil Tag.

title: Foil Tag
text: Foil Tag: The Jokerless challenge bans Foil Tag. Strategy: As the Foil Edition is the most commonly obtainable Edition, either by natural means, purchasing Hone and Glow Up, or successfully activating a The Wheel of Fortune, this Tag may seem underwhelming at first. However, having a single Foil Edition Joker can supplement or remove the need to obtain a Chips dedicated Joker. This Tag is also significantly more beneficial on the Plasma Deck which benefits more in the early to mid game from Chips value, making it a potentially worthwhile skip in an early Ante.

title: Garbage Tag
text: Garbage Tag: Garbage Tag (Tag). Description: Gives $1 per unused discard this run, (Will give $0). Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Garbage Tag makes the player gain $1 for each discard that was not used during the entire run so far.

title: Garbage Tag
text: Garbage Tag: For example, if a player has 3 discards per round, played 6 rounds so far (totaling to 18 discards in this case) and used 6 discards across the entire run, then they would have 18 - 6 = 12 unused discards, so they would gain $12.[verify] It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: On Blue Stake difficulty or higher, Garbage tag will get $1 less per round. Trivia: Before Update 0.9.3i, the effect of Garbage Tag were starting round with an extra 3 Discards. This is changed in later versions.

title: Handy Tag
text: Handy Tag: Handy Tag (Tag). Description: Gives $1 per played hand this run, (Will give $0). Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Handy Tag makes the player gain $1 for every hand that they have played during the entire run.

title: Handy Tag
text: Handy Tag: For example, if they played 20 hands across the entire run, they would get $20. It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Jokers: This tag synergizes with Jokers that encourage playing as many hands as possible, such as Supernova, Spare Trousers, Ride the Bus, Green Joker, and Square Joker as well as Burglar, which allows the player to play more hands.

title: Holographic Tag
text: Holographic Tag: Holographic Tag (Tag). Description: Next base edition shop Joker is free and becomes Holographic. Appearing from Ante: Any. Unlock Requirement: Discover the Holographic edition. The Holographic Tag makes the next base edition Joker found in The Shop cost $0 and come with a Holographic edition.

title: Holographic Tag
text: Holographic Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: If there are no base edition Jokers in the next shop, this Tag will instead be stored. Works with the Uncommon Tag and Rare Tag if the generated Joker does not have an edition naturally. On Black Stake and higher, the Joker affected by the Holographic Tag can have any in-run Sticker that is available for that Stake. The Jokerless challenge bans Holographic Tag.

title: Investment Tag
text: Investment Tag: Investment Tag (Tag). Description: After defeating the Boss Blind. gain $25. Appearing from Ante: Any. The Investment Tag makes the player gain an extra $25 once a Boss Blind is defeated.

title: Investment Tag
text: Investment Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: Multiple Investment Tags can be redeemed, or "stacked", on a single Boss Blind. The tag will be redeemed even if the player was saved by Mr. Bones.

title: Investment Tag
text: Investment Tag: The tag will be redeemed even if the player was saved by Mr. Bones. Strategy: The Investment Tag is considered by many players to be one of the best, if not the best tag in the game, especially if found early on. Unless the player is in massive debt, $25 is usually enough money to buy plenty of things at the Shop, as well as instantly hitting the interest cap (assuming the player doesn't have the Seed Money voucher). As players progress during the run and get their economy under control, the Investment Tag becomes less worth it unless the player is really in a pinch, especially since the tag only takes effect once beating the Boss Blind and the player can potentially make more than $25 just by playing through the Antes normally depending on their build. During Purple Stake and higher, the scores necessary to progress further in the Antes becomes too high to afford skipping at least one Shop over.

title: Juggle Tag
text: Juggle Tag: Juggle Tag (Tag). Description: +3 hand size next round. Appearing from Ante: Any. The Juggle Tag temporarily increases the hand size by +3 for the next round only.

title: Juggle Tag
text: Juggle Tag: It is a tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: If multiple copies of this Tag are held, all copies will be redeemed on the same round, each adding an additional +3 Hand size. This can be used to counter The Manacle's ability of reducing the hand size by 1. With one Juggle Tag, the net hand size change is +2. Trivia: The Juggle Tag has a similar name to Juggler. Juggler gives +1 hand size, similar to the +3 hand size that the Juggle Tag gives.

title: Juggle Tag
text: Juggle Tag: While it is significantly more difficult, this tag can be used with the Anaglyph Deck to achieve Naneinf without using Burglar and The Serpent.

title: Meteor Tag
text: Meteor Tag: Meteor Tag (Tag). Description: Gives a free Mega Celestial Pack. Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Meteor Tag makes the player acquire and then immediately open a Mega Celestial Pack for free. This Booster Pack would allow for the player to choose 2 Planet cards among 5 that are presented.

title: Meteor Tag
text: Meteor Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination) can be activated as normal. Unlike the Orbital Tag, where no planet cards can be acquired, Satellite and Constellation can scale with this tag.

title: Negative Tag
text: Negative Tag: Negative Tag (Tag). Description: Next base edition shop Joker is free and becomes Negative. Appearing from Ante: 2+. Unlock Requirement: Discover the Negative edition. The Negative Tag makes the next base edition Joker found in the Shop cost $0 and come with a Negative edition.

title: Negative Tag
text: Negative Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This Tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: If there are no base edition Jokers in the next shop, this Tag will instead be stored. Works with the Uncommon Tag and Rare Tag if the generated Joker does not have an edition naturally. On Black Stake and higher, the Joker affected by the Negative Tag can have any in-run Sticker that is available for that Stake. The Jokerless challenge bans Negative Tag.

title: Negative Tag
text: Negative Tag: The Jokerless challenge bans Negative Tag. Strategy: While Negative Jokers can be very useful, in the case of this tag it will be applied to a random Joker from the Shop. There's no guarantee the Joker will be useful or even usable at all to a given build, and skipping a blind costs skipping the benefits and opportunities from playing a blind and visiting the subsequent shop. That said the Negative Joker will definitely bring the benefits any regular Negative brings, such as increasing Temperance's value and nullifying the Verdant Leaf Boss Blind.

title: Negative Tag
text: Negative Tag: The latter benefit is less likely to take place on Black Stake and higher, as the Joker made Negative by the tag can potentially appear with an Eternal, and thus cannot be sold to disable the boss blind. Due to Anaglyph Deck's innate ability of generating Double Tags upon defeating a Boss Blind, it is possible to stack a substantial amount of them and collect a Negative Tag when it appears, thus transforming all the collected Double Tags into Negative Tags. The risk of a Negative Tag hitting a useless Joker may be reduced, but this is still very much a high risk strategy.

title: Negative Tag
text: Negative Tag: A Negative Tag hitting a useless Joker may still be beneficial as owning it will prevent it from appearing it in the shop again, unless Showman is active. This is a commonly suggested strategy for players looking to obtain Completionist++, however, the effectiveness of this strategy gradually reduces with the amount of Gold Stickers owned, and the player will often win runs less, at the trade off of each win earning more Gold Stickers at once. If the player wishes to take the Negative Tag at any point, it's imperative that the current Joker build can accommodate for missing a Shop and the bigger Blind requirements, especially on higher stakes.

title: Negative Tag
text: Negative Tag: Trivia: The Negative Tag is the only edition-related Tag that cannot appear in Ante 1.

title: Orbital Tag
text: Orbital Tag: Orbital Tag (Tag). Description: Upgrade [poker hand] by 3 levels. Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Orbital Tag makes a random Poker Hand level up three times.

title: Orbital Tag
text: Orbital Tag: For example, if the tag has chosen to level up the High Card poker hand (which is 5 Chips x 1 Mult at level 1), it would be upgraded to level 4, where it would be 35 Chips x 4 Mult instead. It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: Unlike the Meteor Tag, Satellite and Constellation do not scale with this tag, since no planet cards were used. The hand can be a secret hand if it has already been played in this run.

title: Polychrome Tag
text: Polychrome Tag: Polychrome Tag (Tag). Description: Next base edition shop Joker is free and becomes Polychrome. Appearing from Ante: Any. Unlock Requirement: Discover the Polychrome edition. The Polychrome Tag makes the next base edition Joker found in The Shop cost $0 and come with a Polychrome edition.

title: Polychrome Tag
text: Polychrome Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: If there are no base edition Jokers in the next shop, this Tag will instead be stored. Works with the Uncommon Tag and Rare Tag if the generated Joker does not have an edition naturally. On Black Stake and higher, the Joker affected by the Polychrome Tag can have any in-run Sticker that is available for that Stake. The Jokerless challenge bans Polychrome Tag.

title: Rare Tag
text: Rare Tag: Rare Tag (Tag). Description: Shop has a free Rare Joker. Appearing from Ante: Any. Unlock Requirement: Discover Blueprint. The Rare Tag makes a free Rare Joker available in the next Shop.

title: Rare Tag
text: Rare Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This Tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: The Rare Tag doesn't show up until the player has discovered the Blueprint Joker, which unlocks when you win a run. The Joker generated by the Rare Tag can spawn with an Edition and in-run Stickers (on Black Stake or higher). The Joker is forcefully generated when entering the next Shop, and thus unaffected by Vouchers that lower the probability of Jokers appearing in the Shop, or certain Challenges that prevent Jokers from appearing in the Shop (like Bram Poker).

title: Rare Tag
text: Rare Tag: Multiple Rare Tags or Uncommon Tag will take effect in order, until there are no more open slots available in the current shop. Rerolling the shop will let any remaining Rare/Uncommon Tags take effect. If the player has edition Tags (Foil Tag, Holographic Tag, Polychrome Tag, Negative Tag) at the same time, the edition Tag will take effect after the Rare Tag, and the edition will be applied to the generated Rare Joker if it was generated without edition.

title: Rare Tag
text: Rare Tag: If the player is already holding all 20 Rare Jokers, the Rare Tag will generate nothing and say "NOPE" instead. Due to a bug, this will occur even when holding Showman, and does not behave correctly on challenge decks which ban any Rare Jokers (currently only Non-Perishable). The Jokerless challenge bans Rare Tag. Trivia: This is the only Tag that can still "NOPE", after an update that removed the fail chance for all Tags. There is no similar implementation for the Uncommon Tag.

title: Speed Tag
text: Speed Tag: Speed Tag (Tag). Description: Gives $5 per skipped Blind this run, (Will give $5). Appearing from Ante: Any. The Speed Tag gives $5 for each blind that is skipped, including the Speed Tag itself.

title: Speed Tag
text: Speed Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This Tag starts to appear at Ante 1. Notes: Unlike some other economy tags, like Investment Tag, and Economy Tag, the amount of money gained per skip is not capped. Speed Tag gives more than Investment Tag ($25) after 5+ skips. Speed Tag gives more than Economy Tag (Max of $40) after 8+ skips. Synergies: Throwback and Speed Tag both scale with the total number of previously skipped Blinds, though the player should still be selective about which Blinds to skip.

title: Speed Tag
text: Speed Tag: Trivia: The name of this Tag is similar to the Speedrunner achievement, which requires the player to skip Blinds to win a run in 12 or fewer rounds.

title: Standard Tag
text: Standard Tag: Standard Tag (Tag). Description: Gives a free Mega Standard Pack. Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Standard Tag makes the player acquire and then immediately open a Mega Standard Pack for free. This Booster Pack allows the player to choose 2 Playing cards among 5 that are presented.

title: Standard Tag
text: Standard Tag: It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag may appear on or after Ante 2. Notes: The Fragile challenge bans Standard Tag. Other effects of opening Booster Packs (like Red Card and Hallucination) can be activated as normal. Hologram can benefit by receiving X0.25 Mult for each added card.

title: Top-up Tag
text: Top-up Tag: Top-up Tag (Tag). Description: Create up to 2 Common Jokers, (Must have room). Appearing from Ante: 2+. The Top-up Tag creates up to 2 Common Jokers without Stickers.

title: Top-up Tag
text: Top-up Tag: If there is only one joker slot left, at most one common joker would spawn. Furthermore, if there are no more slots, the tag would activate but make no change to the joker panel, as there is no space left. It is a Tag that can be acquired either by skipping a Small Blind or a Big Blind. This tag starts to appear at Ante 2. Notes: This Tag is similar to the Buffoon Tag, as they both give 2 Jokers and appear starting at Ante 2. However, the Jokers from the Mega Buffoon Pack can be picked from, can have in-run Stickers, and do not have to be Common.

title: Top-up Tag
text: Top-up Tag: Jokers that are generated from Top-up Tag during the Non-Perishable challenge will still receive an Eternal sticker. The Jokerless challenge bans Top-up Tag. Strategies: The Top-up Tag is best taken when the player has no scoring Jokers, and should not be taken to replace already held scoring Jokers, as getting a good scoring Joker from the Top-up Tag is unreliable. The Top-up Tag becomes more powerful on higher stakes, especially Gold Stake, as it guarantees the Jokers will have no in-run Stickers.
